Dialogue.Name: jozef_intro_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Dzień dobry! Mam na imię Józef.
Dialogue.English: Good morning! My name is Józef.

Dialogue.Name: jozef_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: Welcome to our town!

Dialogue.Name: jozef_intro_0_2
Dialogue.Text: Mam problem. Nie widzę bez okularów.
Dialogue.English: I have a problem. I can't see without my glasses.

Dialogue.Name: jozef_intro_0_3
Dialogue.English: Can you find my glasses?

Dialogue.Name: jozef_intro_0_4
Dialogue.English: I think they're by the fountain.

Dialogue.Name: jozef_done_0_0
Dialogue.English: My glasses! Thank you very much!

Dialogue.Name: jozef_done_0_1
Dialogue.English: Now I can see everything.

Dialogue.Name: jozef_after_0_0
Dialogue.English: What a beautiful day!

Dialogue.Name: jozef_after_0_1
Dialogue.English: I like this square.

Dialogue.Name: jozef_after_0_2
Dialogue.English: My granddaughter lives in Kraków.

Dialogue.Name: jozef_remind_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Moje okulary są chyba przy fontannie.
Dialogue.English: My glasses are probably by the fountain.

Dialogue.Name: jozef_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: That's not what I'm looking for.

Dialogue.Name: jozef_receive_0_0
Dialogue.Text: List dla mnie? Od mojej wnuczki!
Dialogue.English: A letter for me? From my granddaughter!

Dialogue.Name: jozef_receive_0_1
Dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

Dialogue.Name: filemon_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Meow! I'm Filemon.

Dialogue.Name: filemon_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I'm very hungry.

Dialogue.Name: filemon_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: Bring me some milk, please.

Dialogue.Name: filemon_intro_0_3
Dialogue.English: The milk is in the café.

Dialogue.Name: filemon_done_0_0
Dialogue.English: Yum! Delicious milk!

Dialogue.Name: filemon_done_0_1
Dialogue.English: Now I'm off to bed.

Dialogue.Name: filemon_after_0_0
Dialogue.English: Purr... I'm a cat, not a dog.

Dialogue.Name: filemon_after_0_1
Dialogue.English: Meow! Burek is my friend.

Dialogue.Name: filemon_remind_0_0
Dialogue.English: Meow! Where's the milk?

Dialogue.Name: filemon_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: Meow? I don't want that.

Dialogue.Name: marek_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Good morning! I'm Marek.

Dialogue.Name: marek_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I sell fruit and vegetables.

Dialogue.Name: marek_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: Oh dear, the fruit fell off the stall!

Dialogue.Name: marek_intro_0_3
Dialogue.English: Bring me an apple, please.

Dialogue.Name: marek_intro_0_4
Dialogue.Text: Owoce leżą na ziemi, obok straganu.
Dialogue.English: The fruit is lying on the ground, next to the stall.

Dialogue.Name: marek_done_0_0
Dialogue.English: Great! Thank you!

Dialogue.Name: marek_done_0_1
Dialogue.English: Now help me a little more.

Dialogue.Name: marek_remind_0_0
Dialogue.English: The apple is lying on the ground.

Dialogue.Name: marek_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: No, that's not it.

Dialogue.Name: basia_intro_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Dzień dobry! Mam na imię Basia.
Dialogue.English: Good morning! My name is Basia.

Dialogue.Name: basia_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I'm a baker. I bake bread every day.

Dialogue.Name: basia_intro_0_2
Dialogue.Text: Ola z kawiarni czeka na chleb.
Dialogue.English: Ola from the café is waiting for bread.

Dialogue.Name: basia_intro_0_3
Dialogue.Text: Zanieś ten chleb do kawiarni, proszę.
Dialogue.English: Please take this bread to the café.

Dialogue.Name: basia_thanks_0_0
Dialogue.English: Thanks for the help!

Dialogue.Name: basia_regive_0_0
Dialogue.English: Here, this is the bread for Ola.

Dialogue.Name: basia_remind_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Kawiarnia jest po drugiej stronie rynku.
Dialogue.English: The café is on the other side of the square.

Dialogue.Name: basia_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: No, that's not it.

Dialogue.Name: ola_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Hi! I'm Ola.

Dialogue.Name: ola_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I work in the café.

Dialogue.Name: ola_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: Do you like coffee or tea?

Dialogue.Name: ola_intro_0_3
Dialogue.English: I like coffee with milk.

Dialogue.Name: ola_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: Hmm, that's not it.

Dialogue.Name: ola_receive_0_0
Dialogue.Text: O, świeży chleb od Basi! Dziękuję!
Dialogue.English: Oh, fresh bread from Basia! Thank you!

Dialogue.Name: kuba_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Hi! My name is Kuba.

Dialogue.Name: kuba_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I'm seven years old.

Dialogue.Name: kuba_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: Where is my ball?

Dialogue.Name: kuba_intro_0_3
Dialogue.English: I kicked it really hard.

Dialogue.Name: kuba_intro_0_4
Dialogue.English: I think it's behind the town hall.

Dialogue.Name: kuba_done_0_0
Dialogue.English: My ball! Hooray!

Dialogue.Name: kuba_done_0_1
Dialogue.English: Let's play together!

Dialogue.Name: kuba_remind_0_0
Dialogue.English: The ball is probably behind the town hall.

Dialogue.Name: kuba_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: No, no! That's not it.

Dialogue.Name: zosia_intro_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Dzień dobry! Mam na imię Zosia.
Dialogue.English: Good morning! My name is Zosia.

Dialogue.Name: zosia_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I sell flowers.

Dialogue.Name: zosia_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: Unfortunately I've lost my keys.

Dialogue.Name: zosia_intro_0_3
Dialogue.English: I can't open the flower shop.

Dialogue.Name: zosia_intro_0_4
Dialogue.English: Maybe they're under a bench?

Dialogue.Name: zosia_done_0_0
Dialogue.English: My keys! Thank you!

Dialogue.Name: zosia_done_0_1
Dialogue.English: Now I can open the flower shop.

Dialogue.Name: zosia_remind_0_0
Dialogue.English: The keys are maybe under a bench.

Dialogue.Name: zosia_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: Unfortunately, that's not it.

Dialogue.Name: ewa_intro_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Dzień dobry! Mam na imię Ewa.
Dialogue.English: Good morning! My name is Ewa.

Dialogue.Name: ewa_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I'm a painter. I'm painting the square.

Dialogue.Name: ewa_intro_0_2
Dialogue.Text: Niebo jest niebieskie, a słońce jest żółte.
Dialogue.English: The sky is blue and the sun is yellow.

Dialogue.Name: ewa_intro_0_3
Dialogue.Text: Ale zgubiłam pędzel! Nie mogę malować.
Dialogue.English: But I've lost my brush! I can't paint.

Dialogue.Name: ewa_intro_0_4
Dialogue.English: I think it's by the town hall.

Dialogue.Name: ewa_done_0_0
Dialogue.English: My brush! Thank you!

Dialogue.Name: ewa_done_0_1
Dialogue.English: Now I need paint.

Dialogue.Name: ewa_remind_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój pędzel jest chyba przy ratuszu.
Dialogue.English: My brush is probably by the town hall.

Dialogue.Name: ewa_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: Oh dear, that's not it.

Dialogue.Name: tadeusz_intro_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Dzień dobry! Mam na imię Tadeusz.
Dialogue.English: Good morning! My name is Tadeusz.

Dialogue.Name: tadeusz_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I'm a postman. I work at the post office.

Dialogue.Name: tadeusz_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: I have a letter for Józef.

Dialogue.Name: tadeusz_intro_0_3
Dialogue.English: Please take him this letter.

Dialogue.Name: tadeusz_intro_0_4
Dialogue.English: Józef is by the fountain.

Dialogue.Name: tadeusz_thanks_0_0
Dialogue.English: Good job! Thank you.

Dialogue.Name: tadeusz_regive_0_0
Dialogue.English: Here, this is the letter for Józef.

Dialogue.Name: tadeusz_remind_0_0
Dialogue.English: Józef is by the fountain.

Dialogue.Name: tadeusz_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: No, that's not it.

Dialogue.Name: halina_intro_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Dzień dobry! Mam na imię Halina.
Dialogue.English: Good morning! My name is Halina.

Dialogue.Name: halina_intro_0_1
Dialogue.Text: Pracuję w księgarni. Bardzo lubię czytać.
Dialogue.English: I work in the bookshop. I really like reading.

Dialogue.Name: halina_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: I've lost my bag of books.

Dialogue.Name: halina_intro_0_3
Dialogue.English: I was by the sandpit this morning.

Dialogue.Name: halina_intro_0_4
Dialogue.English: Maybe it's there?

Dialogue.Name: halina_done_0_0
Dialogue.English: My bag! Thank you!

Dialogue.Name: halina_done_0_1
Dialogue.English: The books are inside. Great!

Dialogue.Name: halina_remind_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Moja torba jest chyba przy piaskownicy.
Dialogue.English: My bag is probably by the sandpit.

Dialogue.Name: halina_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: Hmm, that's not it.

Dialogue.Name: burek_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Woof, woof! I'm Burek.

Dialogue.Name: burek_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I'm a dog, not a cat.

Dialogue.Name: burek_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: Where's my bone?

Dialogue.Name: burek_intro_0_3
Dialogue.English: I think it's under a tree.

Dialogue.Name: burek_done_0_0
Dialogue.English: Woof, woof! My bone!

Dialogue.Name: burek_done_0_1
Dialogue.English: Now I'm happy.

Dialogue.Name: burek_after_0_0
Dialogue.English: Woof! I like Filemon.

Dialogue.Name: burek_after_0_1
Dialogue.English: Woof, woof! Let's go for a walk!

Dialogue.Name: burek_after_0_2
Dialogue.English: Woof! Goodbye!

Dialogue.Name: burek_remind_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Hau! Moja kość jest pod drzewem.
Dialogue.English: Woof! My bone is under a tree.

Dialogue.Name: burek_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: Woof? I don't want that.

Dialogue.Name: zuzia_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Hi! My name is Zuzia.

Dialogue.Name: zuzia_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I like counting!

Dialogue.Name: zuzia_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: One, two, three, four, five!

Dialogue.Name: zuzia_intro_0_3
Dialogue.English: But I've lost my skipping rope.

Dialogue.Name: zuzia_intro_0_4
Dialogue.English: I think it's next to the fountain.

Dialogue.Name: zuzia_done_0_0
Dialogue.English: My skipping rope! Thank you!

Dialogue.Name: zuzia_done_0_1
Dialogue.English: Now let's count together!

Dialogue.Name: zuzia_remind_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Moja skakanka jest chyba obok fontanny.
Dialogue.English: My skipping rope is probably next to the fountain.

Dialogue.Name: zuzia_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: No, no! That's not it.

Dialogue.Name: zuzia_quiz_start_0_0
Dialogue.English: Let's count!

Dialogue.Name: zuzia_quiz_start_0_1
Dialogue.English: A riddle!

Dialogue.Name: zuzia_quiz_more_0_0
Dialogue.English: One more time!

Dialogue.Name: zuzia_quiz_more_0_1
Dialogue.English: Next riddle!

Dialogue.Name: staszek_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Good morning! I'm Staszek.

Dialogue.Name: staszek_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I'm a musician. I play the accordion.

Dialogue.Name: staszek_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: The wind blew my sheet music away!

Dialogue.Name: staszek_intro_0_3
Dialogue.English: I can't play without my music.

Dialogue.Name: staszek_intro_0_4
Dialogue.English: I think it's by a tree.

Dialogue.Name: staszek_done_0_0
Dialogue.English: My music! Thank you!

Dialogue.Name: staszek_done_0_1
Dialogue.English: Now I'll play a song.

Dialogue.Name: staszek_after_0_0
Dialogue.English: Do you like music?

Dialogue.Name: staszek_after_0_1
Dialogue.English: I play the accordion.

Dialogue.Name: staszek_after_0_2
Dialogue.English: Let's sing together!

Dialogue.Name: staszek_after_0_3
Dialogue.English: This song is very old.

Dialogue.Name: staszek_remind_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Moje nuty są chyba przy drzewie.
Dialogue.English: My sheet music is probably by a tree.

Dialogue.Name: staszek_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: Hmm, that's not it.

Dialogue.Name: bogdan_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Good morning! I'm Bogdan.

Dialogue.Name: bogdan_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I sell clothes.

Dialogue.Name: bogdan_intro_0_2
Dialogue.Text: Dzisiaj jest zimno i pada deszcz.
Dialogue.English: It's cold today, and it's raining.

Dialogue.Name: bogdan_intro_0_3
Dialogue.English: Everyone wants warm clothes!

Dialogue.Name: bogdan_intro_0_4
Dialogue.English: Help me, please.

Dialogue.Name: bogdan_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: No, that's not it.

Dialogue.Name: krysia_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Good morning! I'm Grandma Krysia.

Dialogue.Name: krysia_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I'm feeding the pigeons.

Dialogue.Name: krysia_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: But I have no more bread.

Dialogue.Name: krysia_intro_0_3
Dialogue.English: The pigeons are hungry.

Dialogue.Name: krysia_intro_0_4
Dialogue.Text: Przynieś mi bułkę z piekarni, proszę.
Dialogue.English: Bring me a roll from the bakery, please.

Dialogue.Name: krysia_done_0_0
Dialogue.English: Thank you, dear!

Dialogue.Name: krysia_done_0_1
Dialogue.English: The pigeons are happy.

Dialogue.Name: krysia_after_0_0
Dialogue.English: Józef is my brother.

Dialogue.Name: krysia_after_0_1
Dialogue.English: Kuba is my grandson.

Dialogue.Name: krysia_after_0_2
Dialogue.English: Basia is my daughter.

Dialogue.Name: krysia_after_0_3
Dialogue.English: I have a big family.

Dialogue.Name: krysia_remind_0_0
Dialogue.English: The rolls are in the bakery.

Dialogue.Name: krysia_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: No, dear, that's not it.

Dialogue.Name: ania_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Hey! I'm Ania.

Dialogue.Name: ania_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: Sorry, can you help me?

Dialogue.Name: ania_intro_0_2
Dialogue.Text: Nie wiem, gdzie jest mój telefon.
Dialogue.English: I don't know where my phone is.

Dialogue.Name: ania_intro_0_3
Dialogue.Text: Byłam tu rano, a teraz go nie ma.
Dialogue.English: I was here this morning, and now it's gone.

Dialogue.Name: ania_intro_0_4
Dialogue.English: Maybe it's somewhere by the pond?

Dialogue.Name: ania_done_0_0
Dialogue.English: Really? My phone! Thank you!

Dialogue.Name: ania_done_0_1
Dialogue.English: You're great!

Dialogue.Name: ania_remind_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój telefon jest chyba przy stawie.
Dialogue.English: My phone is probably by the pond.

Dialogue.Name: ania_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: No, that's not it.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_0_0
Dialogue.English: How are you?

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_0_1
Dialogue.English: I'm fine. And you?

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_1_0
Dialogue.English: What are you doing today?

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_1_1
Dialogue.English: I have to study.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_1_2
Dialogue.English: I have an exam tomorrow.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_2_0
Dialogue.English: You know what? I like this park.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_2_1
Dialogue.English: It's so quiet here.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_3_0
Dialogue.English: I think it's going to rain.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_3_1
Dialogue.English: Good thing I have an umbrella.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_4_0
Dialogue.English: Why does everyone walk so fast?

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_4_1
Dialogue.English: I don't understand.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_5_0
Dialogue.English: Nice to see you!

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_5_1
Dialogue.English: If you want, I can help you.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_6_0
Dialogue.English: What happened?

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_6_1
Dialogue.English: I'm just tired.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_7_0
Dialogue.English: It's a beautiful day today.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_7_1
Dialogue.English: Later I'm going to the cinema.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_8_0
Dialogue.English: You have to see this!

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_8_1
Dialogue.English: The ducks have little ones.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_9_0
Dialogue.English: I want to be a doctor.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_9_1
Dialogue.English: Of course, it's hard.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_10_0
Dialogue.English: I'll buy myself an ice cream.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_10_1
Dialogue.English: I've got something for you!

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_11_0
Dialogue.English: That's just what I'm thinking about.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_11_1
Dialogue.English: What are you thinking about?

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_12_0
Dialogue.English: Coffee or tea?

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_12_1
Dialogue.Text: Ja zawsze piję kawę przed egzaminem.
Dialogue.English: I always drink coffee before an exam.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_13_0
Dialogue.English: What next?

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_13_1
Dialogue.Text: Nie wiem, co chcę robić w życiu.
Dialogue.English: I don't know what I want to do in life.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_14_0
Dialogue.English: This is my first exam.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_14_1
Dialogue.English: It's not bad!

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_15_0
Dialogue.English: I'll do it later.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_15_1
Dialogue.Text: Teraz jest zbyt ładnie, żeby się uczyć.
Dialogue.English: It's too nice now to study.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_16_0
Dialogue.Text: Lubię ten park, ponieważ jest tu cicho.
Dialogue.English: I like this park because it's quiet here.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_16_1
Dialogue.English: I like it more and more.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_17_0
Dialogue.English: What are you saying? I can't hear.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_18_0
Dialogue.Text: Zanim pójdę, muszę zadzwonić do mamy.
Dialogue.English: Before I go, I have to call Mum.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_18_1
Dialogue.Text: Nadal nie wiem, co jej powiem.
Dialogue.English: I still don't know what I'll tell her.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_19_0
Dialogue.Text: Możesz mi powiedzieć, która jest godzina?
Dialogue.English: Can you tell me what time it is?

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_20_0
Dialogue.English: What's in your backpack?

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_21_0
Dialogue.English: I need your help.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_21_1
Dialogue.English: Thanks to you I have my phone!

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_22_0
Dialogue.English: I have to go now. See you!

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_23_0
Dialogue.English: I usually study in the library.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_23_1
Dialogue.English: But today it's too nice.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_24_0
Dialogue.English: There were loads of questions in the exam.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_24_1
Dialogue.Text: Odpowiedź na pierwsze pytanie była prosta.
Dialogue.English: The answer to the first question was simple.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_25_0
Dialogue.English: Honestly? I hate maths.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_25_1
Dialogue.English: But I love history.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_26_0
Dialogue.English: I'm trying to understand this text.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_26_1
Dialogue.English: I'm trying, but it's hard.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_27_0
Dialogue.English: I have a small flat near the park.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_27_1
Dialogue.English: I live there with friends.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_28_0
Dialogue.English: At the weekend I'm going to my parents'.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_28_1
Dialogue.English: I prefer tea to coffee.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_29_0
Dialogue.Text: W przyszłości chcę pracować w szpitalu.
Dialogue.English: In the future I want to work in a hospital.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_29_1
Dialogue.English: My future? We'll see.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_30_0
Dialogue.English: I heard Piotr has a ring!

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_30_1
Dialogue.English: That's wonderful!

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_31_0
Dialogue.English: My brother has a new car.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_31_1
Dialogue.Text: Jeździ nim wszędzie, nawet do sklepu.
Dialogue.English: He drives it everywhere, even to the shop.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_31_2
Dialogue.English: I don't have a car.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_32_0
Dialogue.Text: Wiadomo, że kawa pomaga w nauce.
Dialogue.English: Everyone knows coffee helps with studying.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_32_1
Dialogue.Text: To zdecydowanie najlepszy park w mieście.
Dialogue.English: This is definitely the best park in town.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_33_0
Dialogue.Text: Pomyślałam, że pójdę dziś na spacer.
Dialogue.English: I thought I'd go for a walk today.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_33_1
Dialogue.English: Will you come to the cinema with me?

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_33_2
Dialogue.English: Shall we meet tomorrow?

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_34_0
Dialogue.Text: Potrafię dużo rzeczy, ale nie potrafię gotować.
Dialogue.English: I can do lots of things, but I can't cook.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_35_0
Dialogue.English: Go this way, it's quicker.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_35_1
Dialogue.English: Do you fancy an ice cream?

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_36_0
Dialogue.Text: Moja siostra wyszła za mąż w zeszłym roku.
Dialogue.English: My sister got married last year.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_36_1
Dialogue.English: The wedding was beautiful.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_37_0
Dialogue.English: It's been a long day.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_37_1
Dialogue.English: I'm off to bed.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_38_0
Dialogue.English: I'll help you if you like.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_38_1
Dialogue.English: That's kind of you.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_39_0
Dialogue.English: Tomek is trying to ride faster.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_39_1
Dialogue.English: We've got lots of sunshine today.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_39_2
Dialogue.English: That's great!

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_40_0
Dialogue.English: Uni is a hard life.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_40_1
Dialogue.English: But not too long: three years.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_41_0
Dialogue.Text: Uczę się hiszpańskiego. Każdy język jest trudny.
Dialogue.English: I'm learning Spanish. Every language is hard.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_42_0
Dialogue.Text: W wakacje chcę wyjechać nad morze.
Dialogue.English: In the holidays I want to go away to the seaside.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_42_1
Dialogue.English: Spend a week on the beach!

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_43_0
Dialogue.Text: Pociąg odjeżdża ze stacji o ósmej.
Dialogue.English: The train leaves the station at eight.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_43_1
Dialogue.English: I'll go with a friend.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_44_0
Dialogue.English: My friend comes from Kraków.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_44_1
Dialogue.Text: Znam jedną osobę, która mówi po chińsku.
Dialogue.English: I know one person who speaks Chinese.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_45_0
Dialogue.English: I barely have time to eat.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_45_1
Dialogue.English: I'm looking for some work for the holidays.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_46_0
Dialogue.English: I have to hand in my essay by tomorrow.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_46_1
Dialogue.English: I'll start right after my coffee.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_47_0
Dialogue.English: I've no memory for names.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_47_1
Dialogue.English: I want to visit my sister at the weekend.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_48_0
Dialogue.English: I like going out to a club in the evening.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_48_1
Dialogue.English: But not today.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_49_0
Dialogue.Text: Na niebie nie ma ani jednej chmury.
Dialogue.English: There isn't a single cloud in the sky.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_49_1
Dialogue.English: Fresh air does me good.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_49_2
Dialogue.English: The sky is so clear today!

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_50_0
Dialogue.English: I've already tried three times.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_50_1
Dialogue.English: Normally I have lunch at two.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_51_0
Dialogue.English: That's obvious, isn't it?

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_51_1
Dialogue.English: I think the same.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_52_0
Dialogue.English: I wish you a nice day!

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_52_1
Dialogue.English: I live nearby.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_53_0
Dialogue.English: The quickest way is this way.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_53_1
Dialogue.Text: Nie wierz we wszystko, co piszą.
Dialogue.English: Don't believe everything they write.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_54_0
Dialogue.English: I want to watch that film.

Dialogue.Name: ania_chat_54_1
Dialogue.English: I liked it a lot.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Good morning! I'm Mr Wiesław.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I work in the park.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: Is everything all right?

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_0_0
Dialogue.English: People never listen.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_1_0
Dialogue.Text: Kiedy byłem młody, tu nie było parku.
Dialogue.English: When I was young, there was no park here.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_1_1
Dialogue.English: There was only a field here.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_2_0
Dialogue.Text: Znasz Piotra? On czeka na Martę.
Dialogue.English: Do you know Piotr? He's waiting for Marta.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_3_0
Dialogue.English: No problem.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_3_1
Dialogue.English: You can always ask me.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_4_0
Dialogue.English: Who was that?

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_4_1
Dialogue.Text: Nie wiem. Nikt tu nie przychodzi.
Dialogue.English: I don't know. Nobody comes here.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_5_0
Dialogue.English: I'm walking home through the park.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_6_0
Dialogue.English: You should always tell the truth.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_7_0
Dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I don't know.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_8_0
Dialogue.English: I'm often here alone.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_8_1
Dialogue.English: But better late than never.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_9_0
Dialogue.English: Their children always play here.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_9_1
Dialogue.Text: Jesteśmy w parku, więc to normalne.
Dialogue.English: We're in a park, so that's normal.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_10_0
Dialogue.Text: Całe życie pracuję w tym parku.
Dialogue.English: I've worked in this park all my life.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_10_1
Dialogue.English: I work here as a gardener.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_11_0
Dialogue.English: There used to be more people here.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_11_1
Dialogue.English: Well, that's life.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_12_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój Boże, jak ten czas leci!
Dialogue.English: My God, how time flies!

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_12_1
Dialogue.English: I'm old now.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_13_0
Dialogue.Text: Ta pani na ławce to moja żona.
Dialogue.English: The lady on the bench is my wife.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_13_1
Dialogue.English: My wife is always right.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_14_0
Dialogue.English: Why do you ask?

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_14_1
Dialogue.English: Are you looking for something?

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_15_0
Dialogue.English: Long ago there was a forest here.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_15_1
Dialogue.English: There used to be roses here.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_16_0
Dialogue.Text: To jest dobre miejsce na spacer.
Dialogue.English: This is a good place for a walk.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_16_1
Dialogue.English: You can sit here all day.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_17_0
Dialogue.English: These ducks are very clever.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_17_1
Dialogue.Text: Dzieci mogą tu grać, ale nie w stawie!
Dialogue.English: Children can play here, but not in the pond!

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_18_0
Dialogue.English: It's about to rain.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_18_1
Dialogue.English: And earlier it was so nice!

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_19_0
Dialogue.Text: Tyle lat, a ja wciąż tu jestem.
Dialogue.English: So many years, and I'm still here.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_19_1
Dialogue.Text: Kim jest ten chłopiec? A, to Tomek.
Dialogue.English: Who's that boy? Oh, it's Tomek.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_20_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój dom jest tam, za parkiem.
Dialogue.English: My house is over there, past the park.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_20_1
Dialogue.English: There will be new trees here.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_21_0
Dialogue.English: I know all the trees here.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_22_0
Dialogue.Text: Wydaje mi się, że Piotr jest smutny.
Dialogue.English: It seems to me that Piotr is sad.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_22_1
Dialogue.English: You only live once.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_23_0
Dialogue.English: We have lots of time, right?

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_23_1
Dialogue.English: All right, all right. Goodbye!

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_24_0
Dialogue.English: Teresa, where were you?

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_24_1
Dialogue.English: You said you'd be on the bench.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_25_0
Dialogue.English: Teresa asks: did you want some tea?

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_25_1
Dialogue.English: And I always want coffee.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_26_0
Dialogue.English: I tell her: you should rest more.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_26_1
Dialogue.English: Be quiet, Teresa, the ducks are asleep.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_27_0
Dialogue.English: I've worked here since the beginning.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_27_1
Dialogue.Text: Mam sporo pracy: liście, trawa, kosze.
Dialogue.English: I have quite a lot of work: leaves, grass, bins.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_28_0
Dialogue.English: There are leaves everywhere!

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_28_1
Dialogue.English: Suddenly it started to rain.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_29_0
Dialogue.English: My father was a gardener too.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_29_1
Dialogue.Text: Pracowałem z ojcem w tym parku.
Dialogue.English: I worked with my father in this park.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_30_0
Dialogue.English: I had to get up early today.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_30_1
Dialogue.English: Come home, my wife says.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_31_0
Dialogue.Text: Wstawaj! mówi żona o szóstej rano.
Dialogue.English: Get up! my wife says at six in the morning.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_32_0
Dialogue.English: Did you hear? Teresa asks.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_32_1
Dialogue.English: I didn't hear anything.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_33_0
Dialogue.English: Slowly, slowly.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_33_1
Dialogue.English: Another day, more leaves.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_34_0
Dialogue.Text: W pobliżu jest sklep z narzędziami.
Dialogue.English: There's a tool shop nearby.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_34_1
Dialogue.English: I have to fix this bench.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_34_2
Dialogue.Text: Ta ławka stoi tu od dawna.
Dialogue.English: This bench has been here for ages.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_35_0
Dialogue.English: When it rains, the work goes slowly.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_36_0
Dialogue.Text: Mam pięćdziesiąt drzew i tysiące liści.
Dialogue.English: I have fifty trees and thousands of leaves.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_37_0
Dialogue.English: Careful, it's wet here!

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_38_0
Dialogue.Text: Teresa jest moją żoną od czterdziestu lat.
Dialogue.English: Teresa has been my wife for forty years.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_38_1
Dialogue.Text: Z żoną zawsze jemy obiad o drugiej.
Dialogue.English: My wife and I always have lunch at two.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_39_0
Dialogue.English: Quiet! The ducks are asleep.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_39_1
Dialogue.Text: Moje nogi już nie są młode.
Dialogue.English: My legs aren't young any more.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_40_0
Dialogue.Text: Nigdzie nie jest tak ładnie jak tu.
Dialogue.English: Nowhere is as nice as here.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_40_1
Dialogue.English: Flowers grow around the pond.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_41_0
Dialogue.English: Let's say I like my job.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_41_1
Dialogue.English: You'll find peace here.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_42_0
Dialogue.English: I talked to Piotr today.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_42_1
Dialogue.English: I've known that boy since he was little.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_43_0
Dialogue.English: Tomek would like to have a dog.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_43_1
Dialogue.English: He'd make a good gardener.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_44_0
Dialogue.English: Come closer, I'll show you something.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_44_1
Dialogue.English: There's a bench by the pond.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_45_0
Dialogue.English: I'm digging the ground for a new tree.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_45_1
Dialogue.English: There's a path between the trees.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_46_0
Dialogue.English: I'm staying here, and you?

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_46_1
Dialogue.English: There's a tree growing in front of our house.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_47_0
Dialogue.Text: Wiosną sadzę kwiaty, jesienią zbieram liście.
Dialogue.English: In spring I plant flowers, in autumn I gather leaves.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_47_1
Dialogue.English: It was worth the work.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_48_0
Dialogue.English: All this land is the park.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_48_1
Dialogue.Text: Dotąd jest park, a dalej ulica.
Dialogue.English: The park goes up to here, then there's the street.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_49_0
Dialogue.English: I once had a horse.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_49_1
Dialogue.English: My uncle was a gardener too.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_50_0
Dialogue.English: I've done this all my life.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_50_1
Dialogue.Text: Ryby w stawie? Są, ale małe.
Dialogue.English: Fish in the pond? There are, but they're small.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_51_0
Dialogue.English: The wind is coming from the south.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_51_1
Dialogue.English: At noon I eat a sandwich.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_52_0
Dialogue.English: Deep in the soil are the roots.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_52_1
Dialogue.English: Do you hear that sound? It's a woodpecker.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_53_0
Dialogue.Text: Cisza i spokój. Tego mi trzeba.
Dialogue.English: Peace and quiet. That's what I need.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_53_1
Dialogue.English: The rake fell out of my hand.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_54_0
Dialogue.English: I have old trousers for work.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_54_1
Dialogue.Text: Pracujemy razem z żoną od lat.
Dialogue.English: My wife and I have worked together for years.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_55_0
Dialogue.English: Another autumn, more leaves.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_55_1
Dialogue.English: I water the flowers with water from the pond.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_56_0
Dialogue.English: Everything's clean and nice.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_56_1
Dialogue.Text: Kwiaty są ładne w tym roku.
Dialogue.English: The flowers are pretty this year.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_56_2
Dialogue.English: Despite the rain, I'm working.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_57_0
Dialogue.English: Tomek helped me with the leaves.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_57_1
Dialogue.English: Tomek saw a fish in the pond.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_58_0
Dialogue.Text: Pojawił się nowy ptak w parku.
Dialogue.English: A new bird has turned up in the park.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_58_1
Dialogue.English: Birds are flying overhead.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_59_0
Dialogue.English: I went to the shop this morning.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_59_1
Dialogue.English: I'll buy my wife some flowers.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_60_0
Dialogue.Text: Kiedyś była tu łódź na stawie.
Dialogue.English: There used to be a boat on the pond.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_60_1
Dialogue.English: It could do without raining today.

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_61_0
Dialogue.Text: Teresa pyta: co robiłeś cały dzień?
Dialogue.English: Teresa asks: what have you been doing all day?

Dialogue.Name: wieslaw_chat_61_1
Dialogue.English: You're back, Wiesiu! she says when I come home.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Hey! I'm Tomek.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: Well, this is a bit silly...

Dialogue.Name: tomek_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: Someone took my skateboard!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_intro_0_3
Dialogue.English: Maybe it's behind a tree?

Dialogue.Name: tomek_done_0_0
Dialogue.English: There it is! Thanks!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_done_0_1
Dialogue.English: You're really all right.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_remind_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Moja deskorolka jest chyba za drzewem.
Dialogue.English: My skateboard is probably behind a tree.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: No, that's not it.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_0_0
Dialogue.English: What's up? All good?

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_1_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój ojciec mówi, że to niebezpieczne.
Dialogue.English: My dad says it's dangerous.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_1_1
Dialogue.English: But he doesn't know anything.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_2_0
Dialogue.English: I think so too!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_3_0
Dialogue.English: Come here! I'll show you something.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_4_0
Dialogue.English: Tomorrow I'm going to school.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_4_1
Dialogue.English: I don't want to!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_5_0
Dialogue.English: I can't, because Mum's waiting.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_5_1
Dialogue.English: Mum, five more minutes!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_6_0
Dialogue.English: Give me a moment!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_6_1
Dialogue.English: I want more time!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_7_0
Dialogue.English: We can play together, if you want.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_8_0
Dialogue.English: Sure! I'll be here tomorrow.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_9_0
Dialogue.English: What's going on?

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_9_1
Dialogue.English: Go over there and see!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_10_0
Dialogue.English: Stop it! That's not funny.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_10_1
Dialogue.English: I only wanted to play.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_11_0
Dialogue.English: I saw a big fish in the pond!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_11_1
Dialogue.English: I'm telling the truth!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_12_0
Dialogue.English: How does it look? Great, right?

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_12_1
Dialogue.English: I almost know how!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_13_0
Dialogue.English: What does that mean?

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_14_0
Dialogue.Text: Nie mam ani psa, ani kota.
Dialogue.English: I have neither a dog nor a cat.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_15_0
Dialogue.English: Can I go with you?

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_15_1
Dialogue.English: Or come with me!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_16_0
Dialogue.English: I'll be right back!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_16_1
Dialogue.English: Dad, wait for me!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_17_0
Dialogue.English: It's my birthday in a few days!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_17_1
Dialogue.English: I want to have a dog.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_18_0
Dialogue.Text: Każdy dzień jest dobry na deskorolkę.
Dialogue.English: Every day is a good day for skateboarding.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_18_1
Dialogue.English: Do you want to come with us?

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_19_0
Dialogue.English: Who are you waiting for?

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_19_1
Dialogue.Text: Mam dość! Koniec! Idę do domu.
Dialogue.English: I've had enough! That's it! I'm going home.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_20_0
Dialogue.English: OK, OK. So what now?

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_20_1
Dialogue.English: Mum's waiting for us.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_21_0
Dialogue.English: No worries, nothing happened.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_21_1
Dialogue.English: Cool that you're here!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_22_0
Dialogue.English: My dad has a plane!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_22_1
Dialogue.English: No, I'm joking.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_22_2
Dialogue.English: Are you joking?

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_23_0
Dialogue.English: Come on, guys!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_23_1
Dialogue.English: Give me the ball!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_23_2
Dialogue.English: Stop! Not that way!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_24_0
Dialogue.English: You'll see, I'm the best!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_24_1
Dialogue.English: No school at last!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_25_0
Dialogue.English: Tomorrow we're going to the seaside.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_25_1
Dialogue.English: We'll be back on Sunday.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_26_0
Dialogue.Text: Mama mówi, że jestem jeszcze dzieckiem.
Dialogue.English: Mum says I'm still a child.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_26_1
Dialogue.English: Not true!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_27_0
Dialogue.English: I swear, it wasn't me!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_27_1
Dialogue.English: Calm down, Dad!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_28_0
Dialogue.English: Computer games are amazing!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_28_1
Dialogue.English: I've got a new game!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_29_0
Dialogue.Text: Chcę mieć psa, ale tata nie pozwoli.
Dialogue.English: I want a dog, but Dad won't let me.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_30_0
Dialogue.English: My grandad is very tall.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_31_0
Dialogue.English: Sit here, next to me.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_31_1
Dialogue.Text: Nauczyć się jeździć na desce? To proste!
Dialogue.English: Learn to ride a board? It's easy!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_32_0
Dialogue.English: Do you want to eat a sandwich?

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_32_1
Dialogue.Text: Chcę jeść! Jestem głodny jak wilk.
Dialogue.English: I want to eat! I'm as hungry as a wolf.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_33_0
Dialogue.Text: Dziewczynka z mojej klasy ma kota.
Dialogue.English: A girl in my class has a cat.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_33_1
Dialogue.English: My mum works in an office.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_34_0
Dialogue.English: I really fancy an ice cream.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_35_0
Dialogue.English: Uncle, come and see!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_35_1
Dialogue.English: Daddy, will you buy me an ice cream?

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_35_2
Dialogue.English: Daddy promised me a bike.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_36_0
Dialogue.English: I completely forgot about my homework!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_37_0
Dialogue.Text: Mama mówi, że jestem słodki. Fuj!
Dialogue.English: Mum says I'm sweet. Yuck!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_37_1
Dialogue.English: Only sweets are sweet!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_38_0
Dialogue.Text: Wyluzuj, tata, nic mi nie jest.
Dialogue.English: Chill, Dad, I'm fine.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_39_0
Dialogue.English: Pretend I'm asleep? I can do that!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_39_1
Dialogue.English: Can you ride a board?

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_40_0
Dialogue.English: Wait for me!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_40_1
Dialogue.English: Hurry up!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_41_0
Dialogue.English: I've got loads of sweets in my backpack.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_42_0
Dialogue.English: The stars are so high up!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_43_0
Dialogue.English: My knees hurt.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_43_1
Dialogue.English: My nose is frozen!

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_44_0
Dialogue.English: I brush my teeth twice a day.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_45_0
Dialogue.English: My brother hates spinach.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_45_1
Dialogue.Text: Mój brat jest większy ode mnie.
Dialogue.English: My brother is bigger than me.

Dialogue.Name: tomek_chat_46_0
Dialogue.English: Get down from that tree! Mum shouts.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Hi. I'm Piotr.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I'm waiting for Marta.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: She's always late.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_0_0
Dialogue.English: I love her, you know?

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_1_0
Dialogue.English: Do you think she'll come?

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_1_1
Dialogue.English: I hope so.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_2_0
Dialogue.Text: Gdzie ona jest? Już jest późno.
Dialogue.English: Where is she? It's late already.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_3_0
Dialogue.English: I bought her flowers.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_3_1
Dialogue.English: Is that a good idea?

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_4_0
Dialogue.English: Sorry, I don't have time.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_4_1
Dialogue.English: I have to wait for her.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_5_0
Dialogue.Text: Nawet nie wiem, co jej powiem.
Dialogue.English: I don't even know what I'll say to her.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_6_0
Dialogue.English: She's so beautiful.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_6_1
Dialogue.English: I'll do anything to make her happy.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_7_0
Dialogue.English: She's my girlfriend.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_7_1
Dialogue.English: We have to talk when she comes.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_8_0
Dialogue.English: Which flower do you like?

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_8_1
Dialogue.English: It's not about the flowers.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_9_0
Dialogue.English: Will you be here tomorrow?

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_9_1
Dialogue.English: Maybe she'll come tomorrow.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_10_0
Dialogue.English: Is that your backpack?

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_10_1
Dialogue.English: Her brother has the same one.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_11_0
Dialogue.English: Her parents are very nice.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_11_1
Dialogue.English: That's his problem.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_12_0
Dialogue.Text: Myślałem, że ona już nie przyjdzie.
Dialogue.English: I thought she wasn't coming anymore.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_12_1
Dialogue.English: I've been waiting here a long time.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_13_0
Dialogue.Text: Miałem dla niej list, ale go zgubiłem.
Dialogue.English: I had a letter for her, but I lost it.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_13_1
Dialogue.Text: Musi być jakiś sposób, żeby ją przeprosić.
Dialogue.English: There must be some way to say sorry to her.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_14_0
Dialogue.Text: Chciałbym z nią zostać na zawsze.
Dialogue.English: I'd like to stay with her for ever.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_14_1
Dialogue.English: If it weren't for her, I'd be alone.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_15_0
Dialogue.Text: Czuję, że to miłość mojego życia.
Dialogue.English: I feel that this is the love of my life.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_15_1
Dialogue.English: I love her more than myself.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_16_0
Dialogue.English: Do you have someone?

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_16_1
Dialogue.English: Money isn't important.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_17_0
Dialogue.Text: Twoja torba jest ładna. Czy to twoje?
Dialogue.English: Your bag is nice. Is that yours?

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_18_0
Dialogue.Text: Który z tych kwiatów ona lubi?
Dialogue.English: Which of these flowers does she like?

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_18_1
Dialogue.English: Tell me what I should do.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_19_0
Dialogue.Text: Co się stanie, jeśli ona nie przyjdzie?
Dialogue.English: What will happen if she doesn't come?

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_19_1
Dialogue.English: No, she'll definitely come.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_20_0
Dialogue.Text: Chcę tylko wiedzieć, gdzie ona jest.
Dialogue.English: I just want to know where she is.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_20_1
Dialogue.English: I'm waiting until she comes.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_21_0
Dialogue.Text: Nigdy nie widziałem nikogo takiego jak ona.
Dialogue.English: I've never seen anyone like her.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_22_0
Dialogue.Text: Obiecuję, że będę na nią czekał.
Dialogue.English: I promise I'll wait for her.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_22_1
Dialogue.English: I could wait here all day.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_23_0
Dialogue.Text: Muszę się dowiedzieć, czy ona mnie kocha.
Dialogue.English: I have to find out if she loves me.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_24_0
Dialogue.English: I have a ring in my pocket.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_24_1
Dialogue.Text: Pomyślałem, że kwiaty to dobry pomysł.
Dialogue.English: I thought flowers were a good idea.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_25_0
Dialogue.Text: Mogłem kupić róże, ale kupiłem tulipany.
Dialogue.English: I could have bought roses, but I bought tulips.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_26_0
Dialogue.English: I love her with all my heart.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_26_1
Dialogue.English: It's a real feeling.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_26_2
Dialogue.English: I love her just as she is.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_27_0
Dialogue.English: Meeting her was luck.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_27_1
Dialogue.English: I've never met a girl like her.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_28_0
Dialogue.English: I only have one chance.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_28_1
Dialogue.Text: Dziewczynę jak Marta spotyka się raz w życiu.
Dialogue.English: You meet a girl like Marta once in a lifetime.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_29_0
Dialogue.English: I'm a bit scared of Marta's mother.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_30_0
Dialogue.Text: Zamiast czekać, mogę do niej zadzwonić.
Dialogue.English: Instead of waiting, I could phone her.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_30_1
Dialogue.English: But I don't want to leave here.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_31_0
Dialogue.English: Songs about love are the best.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_32_0
Dialogue.Text: Myśl o niej nie daje mi spokoju.
Dialogue.English: The thought of her gives me no peace.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_32_1
Dialogue.English: She'll certainly come.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_33_0
Dialogue.Text: Najlepiej będzie, jak po prostu powiem prawdę.
Dialogue.English: It'll be best if I just tell the truth.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_33_1
Dialogue.English: Everything will turn out fine.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_34_0
Dialogue.English: I want her to be my wife.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_34_1
Dialogue.English: I intend to ask her today.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_34_2
Dialogue.Text: Jestem pewny, że to dobry pomysł.
Dialogue.English: I'm sure it's a good idea.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_35_0
Dialogue.Text: Jej włosy, jej oczy, jej usta...
Dialogue.English: Her hair, her eyes, her lips...

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_35_1
Dialogue.English: In her eyes I see the future.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_35_2
Dialogue.Text: Nie mogę oderwać od niej oczu.
Dialogue.English: I can't take my eyes off her.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_36_0
Dialogue.English: Do you love someone?

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_36_1
Dialogue.English: Think about it.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_37_0
Dialogue.English: I'll make dinner myself.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_37_1
Dialogue.English: I have to get ready.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_38_0
Dialogue.English: I appreciate you talking to me.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_38_1
Dialogue.English: I've made a decision.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_39_0
Dialogue.English: I doubt she knows.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_39_1
Dialogue.English: Will she like it?

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_39_2
Dialogue.English: It'll be a surprise.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_40_0
Dialogue.English: I can't wait.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_40_1
Dialogue.English: I've felt it since the first day.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_41_0
Dialogue.English: I especially like her laugh.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_41_1
Dialogue.Text: Kiedy zobaczyłem ją pierwszy raz, wiedziałem.
Dialogue.English: When I saw her for the first time, I knew.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_42_0
Dialogue.English: Marriage is a serious matter.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_42_1
Dialogue.English: I'm proud of her.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_43_0
Dialogue.English: Everything will go well.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_43_1
Dialogue.English: I want to hear her voice.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_44_0
Dialogue.English: I tried to call her.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_44_1
Dialogue.English: I gave her flowers yesterday too.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_45_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój ojciec myślał, że będę lekarzem.
Dialogue.English: My father thought I'd be a doctor.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_46_0
Dialogue.English: I trust her.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_46_1
Dialogue.English: You have to trust people.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_47_0
Dialogue.English: If we were together, it would be wonderful.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_47_1
Dialogue.English: We'll talk when she comes.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_48_0
Dialogue.Text: Muszę się upewnić, że pierścionek jest w kieszeni.
Dialogue.English: I have to make sure the ring is in my pocket.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_48_1
Dialogue.English: It's hard to hide a ring.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_49_0
Dialogue.English: I met her on a train.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_49_1
Dialogue.English: There's only her in my heart.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_50_0
Dialogue.Text: Tęsknię za nią, kiedy jej nie ma.
Dialogue.English: I miss her when she's not here.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_50_1
Dialogue.Text: Wspomnienia z naszej pierwszej randki są piękne.
Dialogue.English: The memories of our first date are beautiful.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_51_0
Dialogue.English: I'll leave her a letter on the bench.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_51_1
Dialogue.English: She could be here by now.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_52_0
Dialogue.English: Her smile is everything.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_52_1
Dialogue.English: Without hope there's no life.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_52_2
Dialogue.English: Let's hope!

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_53_0
Dialogue.English: Darling, where are you?

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_53_1
Dialogue.English: I bought wine for dinner too.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_54_0
Dialogue.English: The worst thing is the waiting.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_54_1
Dialogue.English: The fear of the answer is awful.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_54_2
Dialogue.English: I'm too scared to eat.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_55_0
Dialogue.English: I'll be honest: I'm scared.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_55_1
Dialogue.English: I hope she says yes!

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_56_0
Dialogue.English: I suppose she already knows.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_56_1
Dialogue.English: I regret not asking sooner.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_57_0
Dialogue.Text: Taka para jak my zdarza się rzadko.
Dialogue.English: A couple like us is rare.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_57_1
Dialogue.English: All I want is her happiness.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_58_0
Dialogue.English: Married? Not yet!

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_58_1
Dialogue.English: I'm already planning the wedding date.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_59_0
Dialogue.English: I have no doubts.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_59_1
Dialogue.English: I won't change my mind.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_60_0
Dialogue.English: I want to make her happy.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_60_1
Dialogue.English: I was wondering what to say.

Dialogue.Name: piotr_chat_60_2
Dialogue.English: She'll see the ring, and what will she say?

Dialogue.Name: teresa_intro_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Dzień dobry. Mam na imię Teresa.
Dialogue.English: Good morning. My name is Teresa.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: Do you know my husband, Mr Wiesław?

Dialogue.Name: teresa_intro_0_2
Dialogue.Text: On tu pracuje, a ja tu siedzę.
Dialogue.English: He works here, and I sit here.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_0_0
Dialogue.English: Do you see that duck?

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_0_1
Dialogue.English: She's lived here for a year.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_0_2
Dialogue.English: I give them bread.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_1_0
Dialogue.English: Our children live far away.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_1_1
Dialogue.Text: Dzwonią do nas tylko kilka razy w roku.
Dialogue.English: They only phone us a few times a year.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_1_2
Dialogue.English: I think about them all the time.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_2_0
Dialogue.English: Many things change.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_2_1
Dialogue.English: But the park stays the same.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_3_0
Dialogue.Text: Słuchaj, ten sweter jest dla mojego wnuka.
Dialogue.English: Listen, this jumper is for my grandson.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_4_0
Dialogue.Text: Ciągle zapominam, gdzie są moje okulary.
Dialogue.English: I keep forgetting where my glasses are.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_4_1
Dialogue.English: Oh, I've got them!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_5_0
Dialogue.Text: Posłuchaj: nigdy nie jest za późno.
Dialogue.English: Listen: it's never too late.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_6_0
Dialogue.Text: Spójrz, jak te dzieci się bawią!
Dialogue.English: Look how those children are playing!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_6_1
Dialogue.English: How lovely that is!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_7_0
Dialogue.English: It's so peaceful by the pond.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_7_1
Dialogue.English: We'll be here until evening.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_8_0
Dialogue.English: I know everyone here.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_8_1
Dialogue.Text: Ta pani z psem jest bardzo miła.
Dialogue.English: The lady with the dog is very nice.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_9_0
Dialogue.English: Some child is crying over there.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_9_1
Dialogue.English: I don't like being alone.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_10_0
Dialogue.Text: U nas w domu zawsze jest kawa.
Dialogue.English: At our place there's always coffee.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_10_1
Dialogue.Text: Co dzisiaj? To samo co zawsze.
Dialogue.English: What today? The same as always.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_11_0
Dialogue.English: Mr Wiesław! Where is he?

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_11_1
Dialogue.Text: Tak mówię do męża, kiedy jestem zła.
Dialogue.English: That's what I call my husband when I'm cross.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_12_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój mąż ma swoje zdanie o wszystkim.
Dialogue.English: My husband has his own opinion about everything.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_12_1
Dialogue.Text: Co on robi? Co on o tym myśli? Nie wiem.
Dialogue.English: What's he doing? What does he think about it? I don't know.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_13_0
Dialogue.Text: Dobrze by było, gdyby nie padało.
Dialogue.English: It'd be good if it didn't rain.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_14_0
Dialogue.Text: Dzieci, mówię wam: uwaga na kaczki!
Dialogue.English: Children, I'm telling you: mind the ducks!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_14_1
Dialogue.Text: Nie ma was w domu cały dzień!
Dialogue.English: You're out of the house all day!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_15_0
Dialogue.Text: Piotr i Marta? Oni są razem od szkoły.
Dialogue.English: Piotr and Marta? They've been together since school.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_15_1
Dialogue.Text: Wszyscy wiemy, że on ją kocha.
Dialogue.English: We all know he loves her.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_15_2
Dialogue.English: Anyone can see it!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_16_0
Dialogue.Text: Mówię do męża: gdzie byłeś cały dzień?
Dialogue.English: I say to my husband: where have you been all day?

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_16_1
Dialogue.Text: A on: w parku, jak zawsze.
Dialogue.English: And he says: in the park, as always.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_17_0
Dialogue.English: Wiesiu, did you do the shopping?

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_17_1
Dialogue.English: No? You said you would!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_18_0
Dialogue.English: You should rest more, I tell him.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_18_1
Dialogue.English: But he doesn't listen to me.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_19_0
Dialogue.Text: Widziałeś moje okulary? Pytam go codziennie.
Dialogue.English: Have you seen my glasses? I ask him every day.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_20_0
Dialogue.Text: Raz w życiu mu powiedziałam: miałeś rację.
Dialogue.English: Once in my life I told him: you were right.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_21_0
Dialogue.English: Wiesiu, what did you say?

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_21_1
Dialogue.English: Wiesiu, could you help me?

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_22_0
Dialogue.Text: Gdybyś mniej pracował, byłbyś mniej zmęczony, mówię mu.
Dialogue.English: If you worked less, you'd be less tired, I tell him.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_22_1
Dialogue.English: I want you to be healthy.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_23_0
Dialogue.English: I'd like you to rest more, Wiesiu.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_24_0
Dialogue.Text: Mąż mówi o swojej pracy cały dzień.
Dialogue.English: My husband talks about his work all day.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_24_1
Dialogue.English: Is my husband back? No, he's still working.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_25_0
Dialogue.English: The whole family is coming on Sunday!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_25_1
Dialogue.English: My daughter should phone more often.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_26_0
Dialogue.English: Children, I'm coming with you!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_27_0
Dialogue.Text: Jestem jego żoną, a on moim mężem.
Dialogue.English: I'm his wife, and he's my husband.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_27_1
Dialogue.English: He always did everything for the family.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_28_0
Dialogue.English: Food is love to me.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_28_1
Dialogue.English: On Sunday I'll make lots of food.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_29_0
Dialogue.Text: W kuchni to ja jestem szefem!
Dialogue.English: In the kitchen, I'm the boss!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_30_0
Dialogue.English: I have a daughter and a son.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_30_1
Dialogue.Text: Z córką rozmawiam co tydzień, a z synem rzadko.
Dialogue.English: I talk to my daughter every week, and rarely to my son.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_31_0
Dialogue.English: Tomorrow is my sister's name day.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_31_1
Dialogue.English: Both my sisters are older.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_32_0
Dialogue.English: Health is the most important thing.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_32_1
Dialogue.English: How many grandchildren do I have? Five!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_32_2
Dialogue.English: I also have a little grandson, Kuba.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_33_0
Dialogue.English: Look on the bright side!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_33_1
Dialogue.English: There's nothing on TV.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_34_0
Dialogue.Text: Moje okulary? Na dole, w torbie!
Dialogue.English: My glasses? At the bottom, in my bag!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_34_1
Dialogue.English: Or somewhere else.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_35_0
Dialogue.English: Wiesiu, take an umbrella!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_35_1
Dialogue.English: My husband always takes an umbrella.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_35_2
Dialogue.Text: Mąż trzyma parasol, a ja torbę.
Dialogue.English: My husband holds the umbrella and I hold the bag.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_36_0
Dialogue.English: Every woman has her secrets.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_36_1
Dialogue.Text: Zastanawiam się, co zrobić na obiad.
Dialogue.English: I'm wondering what to make for lunch.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_37_0
Dialogue.English: It's worth coming here.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_37_1
Dialogue.English: My, how time flies!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_38_0
Dialogue.Text: Mąż nic nie widzi bez okularów.
Dialogue.English: My husband can't see anything without his glasses.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_38_1
Dialogue.English: My husband is wonderful.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_39_0
Dialogue.Text: Mam tę samą torbę od lat.
Dialogue.English: I've had the same bag for years.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_39_1
Dialogue.Text: Mam małą prośbę: posiedź ze mną.
Dialogue.English: I have a small favour to ask: sit with me a while.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_40_0
Dialogue.Text: Mąż wyszedł rano i jeszcze nie wrócił.
Dialogue.English: My husband left in the morning and hasn't come back yet.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_40_1
Dialogue.Text: W naszej rodzinie wszyscy lubią kawę.
Dialogue.English: In our family everyone likes coffee.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_41_0
Dialogue.English: I love the holidays.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_41_1
Dialogue.English: Every child is different.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_42_0
Dialogue.English: You could have phoned! I tell my daughter.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_42_1
Dialogue.English: My husband can fix anything.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_43_0
Dialogue.English: The flowers look beautiful.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_43_1
Dialogue.English: The ducks live here all year round.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_43_2
Dialogue.English: In summer there's lots of light.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_44_0
Dialogue.Text: Od rana do wieczora siedzę tu z drutami.
Dialogue.English: From morning till evening I sit here with my knitting needles.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_45_0
Dialogue.English: I take medicine for my blood pressure.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_45_1
Dialogue.English: Good health to you!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_46_0
Dialogue.English: I like wearing a hat.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_46_1
Dialogue.Text: Mąż nosi okulary tylko do czytania.
Dialogue.English: My husband only wears glasses for reading.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_47_0
Dialogue.English: We have lots of jars in the cellar.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_47_1
Dialogue.English: I don't like throwing old things away.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_48_0
Dialogue.English: Christmas is still a long way off.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_48_1
Dialogue.Text: Robiła to moja matka, a teraz ja.
Dialogue.English: My mother used to do it, and now I do.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_49_0
Dialogue.English: In the kitchen you need patience.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_49_1
Dialogue.English: After dinner we play cards.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_50_0
Dialogue.Text: Jeszcze troszkę i kończę ten sweter.
Dialogue.English: Just a tiny bit more and I'll finish this jumper.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_50_1
Dialogue.English: A little sugar in your tea?

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_51_0
Dialogue.English: I owe my mother everything.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_51_1
Dialogue.Text: Byliście już w nowej restauracji? pytam dzieci.
Dialogue.English: Have you been to the new restaurant yet? I ask my children.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_52_0
Dialogue.Text: Mam zaszczyt znać wszystkich w parku.
Dialogue.English: I have the honour of knowing everyone in the park.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_52_1
Dialogue.Text: Mąż jest odpowiedzialny za cały park.
Dialogue.English: My husband is responsible for the whole park.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_53_0
Dialogue.English: Wonderful flowers, aren't they?

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_53_1
Dialogue.English: It's warm in a small house.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_54_0
Dialogue.English: Did you have to take so long? I ask my husband.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_54_1
Dialogue.English: Did you give the ducks bread? Good.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_55_0
Dialogue.English: My husband finished work at five.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_55_1
Dialogue.English: My husband talked to Piotr.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_56_0
Dialogue.English: Poor Piotr, he's waiting so long!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_56_1
Dialogue.English: I've loved that man for years.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_57_0
Dialogue.English: My glasses are in the bedroom!

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_57_1
Dialogue.Text: Nie mam już tylu włosów, co kiedyś.
Dialogue.English: I don't have as much hair as I used to.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_58_0
Dialogue.English: My husband's a saint.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_58_1
Dialogue.Text: Mąż zawsze jest u mojego boku.
Dialogue.English: My husband's always at my side.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_59_0
Dialogue.English: Lovely moments with the family.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_59_1
Dialogue.English: I think about all sorts of things.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_60_0
Dialogue.Text: Z naszymi wnukami nigdy nie jest nudno.
Dialogue.English: It's never boring with our grandchildren.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_60_1
Dialogue.English: My hands are full.

Dialogue.Name: teresa_chat_61_0
Dialogue.English: See you this evening!

Dialogue.Name: michal_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Welcome! I'm Michał, the waiter.

Dialogue.Name: michal_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I have a problem: the wind took the menu.

Dialogue.Name: michal_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: I think it's somewhere by the fountain.

Dialogue.Name: michal_done_0_0
Dialogue.English: Here's the menu! Thank you very much.

Dialogue.Name: michal_done_0_1
Dialogue.Text: Co mogę ci dać? Pierwsza kawa jest gratis.
Dialogue.English: What can I give you? The first coffee is on the house.

Dialogue.Name: michal_remind_0_0
Dialogue.English: The menu is probably by the fountain.

Dialogue.Name: michal_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: No, that's not it.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_0_0
Dialogue.English: What can I get you?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_0_1
Dialogue.English: Coffee, tea or something else?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_0_2
Dialogue.English: Small or large?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_1_0
Dialogue.English: Coffee first, then work.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_2_0
Dialogue.English: Do you like our café?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_2_1
Dialogue.Text: W naszej kawiarni jest najlepsza kawa w mieście.
Dialogue.English: Our café has the best coffee in town.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_3_0
Dialogue.English: I've worked here for two years.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_3_1
Dialogue.English: My dad was a waiter too.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_4_0
Dialogue.Text: Podczas pracy nie mam czasu na nic.
Dialogue.English: At work I have no time for anything.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_4_1
Dialogue.English: Not right now either!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_5_0
Dialogue.English: Sorry, I've got a lot of work.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_5_1
Dialogue.English: I should get back to work.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_6_0
Dialogue.Text: Wiecie co? Macie dziś szczęście: jest słońce.
Dialogue.English: You know what, everyone? You're in luck today: it's sunny.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_6_1
Dialogue.English: Is this your first time here?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_7_0
Dialogue.English: And you lot? What can I get you?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_8_0
Dialogue.English: One day I want my own place.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_8_1
Dialogue.Text: Chcemy też mieć więcej stolików na tarasie.
Dialogue.English: We also want more tables on the terrace.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_9_0
Dialogue.Text: Możliwe, że dziś będzie dużo ludzi.
Dialogue.English: There may be lots of people today.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_9_1
Dialogue.English: There's no room left!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_10_0
Dialogue.English: Here, this is for you.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_10_1
Dialogue.English: Take a biscuit, there's enough for everyone.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_11_0
Dialogue.English: Relax, there's no rush.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_11_1
Dialogue.Text: Nie martw się, kawa zaraz będzie.
Dialogue.English: Don't worry, the coffee's coming.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_12_0
Dialogue.Text: Dam ci jedną radę: pij herbatę.
Dialogue.English: I'll give you one piece of advice: drink tea.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_12_1
Dialogue.Text: Jedno pytanie: z cukrem czy bez?
Dialogue.English: One question: with sugar or without?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_13_0
Dialogue.Text: Jeżeli chcesz, możesz tu siedzieć cały dzień.
Dialogue.English: If you like, you can sit here all day.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_13_1
Dialogue.Text: Skoro już tu jesteś, zostań na kawę!
Dialogue.English: Since you're here, stay for a coffee!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_14_0
Dialogue.English: Close the door, please. It's cold.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_15_0
Dialogue.English: Sometimes I work until late at night.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_15_1
Dialogue.English: In my free time I read.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_16_0
Dialogue.Text: Ludzie, którzy tu przychodzą, są bardzo mili.
Dialogue.English: The people who come here are very nice.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_16_1
Dialogue.English: There are no problems at all.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_17_0
Dialogue.English: What can I get you, Mr Zbigniew?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_17_1
Dialogue.English: I've made you a coffee, sir.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_18_0
Dialogue.Text: Słyszałem, że Piotr czeka na Martę.
Dialogue.English: I heard that Piotr is waiting for Marta.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_18_1
Dialogue.English: My girlfriend works at the flower shop.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_19_0
Dialogue.Text: Powiedziałem szefowi, że chcę wolny dzień.
Dialogue.English: I told my boss I want a day off.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_19_1
Dialogue.Text: Mamy nowy ekspres do kawy. Mamy także lody.
Dialogue.English: We have a new coffee machine. We also have ice cream.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_20_0
Dialogue.English: I knew you'd come back!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_20_1
Dialogue.English: Have whatever you like.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_21_0
Dialogue.English: Gentlemen, what can I get you?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_21_1
Dialogue.English: You can sit here.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_22_0
Dialogue.Text: Przepraszam panią, ten stolik jest zajęty.
Dialogue.English: Excuse me, madam, this table is taken.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_23_0
Dialogue.English: Do you want anything else?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_23_1
Dialogue.English: Will you all be here tomorrow?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_24_0
Dialogue.English: We need more milk.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_24_1
Dialogue.English: I'll be right back.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_25_0
Dialogue.Text: Zrobimy dziś coś nowego: kawę z lodami.
Dialogue.English: Today we'll make something new: coffee with ice cream.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_25_1
Dialogue.English: I make the best coffee in town.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_26_0
Dialogue.English: In August I'm going to the mountains.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_26_1
Dialogue.English: I'm going upstairs for the sugar.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_27_0
Dialogue.Text: Toaleta? Na dół i w lewo.
Dialogue.English: The toilet? Downstairs and to the left.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_28_0
Dialogue.Text: Ile kosztuje kawa? Zależy: mała czy duża.
Dialogue.English: How much is a coffee? It depends: small or large.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_28_1
Dialogue.English: Just a moment, please!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_29_0
Dialogue.English: My surname is hard: Grzegorzewski.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_29_1
Dialogue.English: This coffee is called a latte.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_30_0
Dialogue.Text: Rób, co chcesz, ale nie pij za dużo kawy!
Dialogue.English: Do what you like, but don't drink too much coffee!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_31_0
Dialogue.Text: Możesz wejść do środka, jeśli jest zimno.
Dialogue.English: You can come inside if it's cold.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_31_1
Dialogue.English: It's nicer outside.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_31_2
Dialogue.English: Great that you're here!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_32_0
Dialogue.English: Your coffee, everyone.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_32_1
Dialogue.English: Your order is ready!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_33_0
Dialogue.English: Welcome! A table for two?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_33_1
Dialogue.English: Go ahead, sit down!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_34_0
Dialogue.English: Just a moment, please.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_34_1
Dialogue.English: One moment!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_35_0
Dialogue.Text: Piwo? Nie, tu nie ma piwa.
Dialogue.English: Beer? No, there's no beer here.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_35_1
Dialogue.English: Only coffee and tea.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_36_0
Dialogue.English: A piece of cake with your coffee?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_36_1
Dialogue.English: This coffee goes with the biscuit.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_37_0
Dialogue.English: Have a nice day!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_37_1
Dialogue.English: Thank you, and do come again!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_37_2
Dialogue.English: See you tomorrow!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_38_0
Dialogue.English: Sorry, we're out of sugar.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_38_1
Dialogue.English: No harm done!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_39_0
Dialogue.English: Lunch? We have sandwiches from twelve.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_39_1
Dialogue.English: The café closes at six.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_40_0
Dialogue.Text: Za tydzień jest przyjęcie w kawiarni.
Dialogue.English: There's a party in the café in a week.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_40_1
Dialogue.Text: Zespół gra na tarasie w sobotę.
Dialogue.English: A band is playing on the terrace on Saturday.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_41_0
Dialogue.English: There are loads of guests today.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_41_1
Dialogue.English: All the tables are full.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_42_0
Dialogue.English: What can I get you, mate?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_42_1
Dialogue.English: Come in, please! Have a seat!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_43_0
Dialogue.English: Listen, everyone, we've got a new coffee!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_43_1
Dialogue.English: It's a new kind of coffee.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_44_0
Dialogue.English: Are you doing anything this evening? There's a concert.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_45_0
Dialogue.English: I got a tip!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_45_1
Dialogue.Text: Mój szef jest w porządku, zwłaszcza rano.
Dialogue.English: My boss is all right, especially in the mornings.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_46_0
Dialogue.English: The window's open. Shall I close it?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_46_1
Dialogue.English: It's warm inside.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_47_0
Dialogue.English: A big choice of coffee!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_47_1
Dialogue.English: Hard to choose, isn't it?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_47_2
Dialogue.English: We have small and large coffees.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_48_0
Dialogue.English: Wonderful weather today!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_48_1
Dialogue.English: See? I said it would be sunny!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_49_0
Dialogue.English: Excellent!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_49_1
Dialogue.English: I make every coffee with love.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_50_0
Dialogue.English: I want my own place.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_50_1
Dialogue.English: Some of the biscuits have no sugar.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_51_0
Dialogue.English: Would you like a different coffee?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_51_1
Dialogue.English: We have biscuits to go with your coffee.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_52_0
Dialogue.English: You won't need an umbrella today.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_52_1
Dialogue.English: Your friends are already here!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_53_0
Dialogue.English: Lots of women work in the café.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_53_1
Dialogue.Text: Mój ulubiony kolor? Czarny, jak kawa.
Dialogue.English: My favourite colour? Black, like coffee.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_54_0
Dialogue.Text: Kawa na wynos czy na miejscu?
Dialogue.English: Coffee to take away or to have here?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_54_1
Dialogue.English: What will you have?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_55_0
Dialogue.English: The bill, please?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_55_1
Dialogue.English: Are you paying by card or in cash, sir?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_55_2
Dialogue.English: I know the price of the coffee by heart.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_56_0
Dialogue.English: Please put it down here.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_56_1
Dialogue.English: Come up to the bar, please.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_56_2
Dialogue.English: Where shall I put the coffee?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_57_0
Dialogue.English: Sell the café? Never!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_57_1
Dialogue.English: We have the best customers.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_58_0
Dialogue.English: We get new customers every day.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_58_1
Dialogue.English: I greet every customer with a smile.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_59_0
Dialogue.English: Welcome, everyone! Do come inside.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_59_1
Dialogue.English: Everyone knows me here.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_60_0
Dialogue.English: For free? No, but cheap.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_60_1
Dialogue.English: Would you like something to drink?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_61_0
Dialogue.Text: Prysznic po pracy to najlepsza rzecz.
Dialogue.English: A shower after work is the best thing.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_61_1
Dialogue.English: This coffee machine is expensive kit.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_62_0
Dialogue.English: I know the guitarist from that band.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_62_1
Dialogue.English: Their concert is full of energy.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_63_0
Dialogue.Text: Klucz do łazienki jest przy barze.
Dialogue.English: The bathroom key is by the bar.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_63_1
Dialogue.English: With pleasure!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_64_0
Dialogue.English: Congratulations, Kasia! A new job!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_64_1
Dialogue.English: Same to you!

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_65_0
Dialogue.English: Literally everyone comes here.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_65_1
Dialogue.English: Indeed, it's raining.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_66_0
Dialogue.English: If you'd like, we also have tea.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_66_1
Dialogue.English: Another coffee?

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_67_0
Dialogue.English: We have coffee for every occasion.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_67_1
Dialogue.English: Give me a smile in return.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_68_0
Dialogue.English: I have to take an order.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_68_1
Dialogue.English: He was here a moment ago.

Dialogue.Name: michal_chat_69_0
Dialogue.English: I have lots of my own ideas.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Good morning. I'm Mr Zbigniew.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I read the paper here every day.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_intro_0_2
Dialogue.Text: Co nowego na świecie? Zaraz zobaczymy.
Dialogue.English: What's new in the world? We'll see in a moment.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Świat się zmienia, a ja nie.
Dialogue.English: The world changes, but I don't.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_0_1
Dialogue.English: The years fly by.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_1_0
Dialogue.Text: Ta kawiarnia była kiedyś mojego ojca.
Dialogue.English: This café used to be my father's.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_1_1
