Dialogue.English: My father had to work a lot.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_1_2
Dialogue.English: He used to say coffee is life.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_2_0
Dialogue.Text: Moja matka zawsze mówiła: najpierw praca.
Dialogue.English: My mother always said: work first.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_3_0
Dialogue.English: Do you remember what the weather was like yesterday?

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_3_1
Dialogue.English: I told you it would rain!

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_4_0
Dialogue.English: They write that it'll be nice tomorrow.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_4_1
Dialogue.English: I don't believe it.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_4_2
Dialogue.English: It looks as if it's going to rain.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_5_0
Dialogue.Text: W ogóle nic nie rozumiem z tej gazety.
Dialogue.English: I don't understand anything at all in this paper.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_5_1
Dialogue.English: Do you understand any of it?

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_6_0
Dialogue.English: Seriously? That's what they write.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_6_1
Dialogue.Text: Sądzę, że to prawda. Ale nie jestem pewien.
Dialogue.English: I think it's true. But I'm not sure.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_7_0
Dialogue.English: Actually, I like being alone.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_7_1
Dialogue.English: Nobody stayed. Only me.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_8_0
Dialogue.English: My wife had a good heart.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_8_1
Dialogue.English: She was a good woman.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_9_0
Dialogue.Text: Kiedyś byli tu ze mną moi przyjaciele.
Dialogue.English: My friends used to be here with me.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_9_1
Dialogue.Text: Za moich czasów wszystko było inaczej.
Dialogue.English: In my day everything was different.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_9_2
Dialogue.English: Other times, other people.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_10_0
Dialogue.Text: Między nami mówiąc, kawa tu jest za słaba.
Dialogue.English: Between you and me, the coffee here is too weak.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_10_1
Dialogue.English: At least it's hot.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_11_0
Dialogue.Text: Ten facet w gazecie mówi głupoty.
Dialogue.English: This guy in the paper talks nonsense.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_11_1
Dialogue.English: I don't know the man.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_12_0
Dialogue.English: How much does a car cost now?

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_12_1
Dialogue.English: That car's too expensive.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_12_2
Dialogue.English: I don't have money for a car.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_13_0
Dialogue.English: So what? Nothing new.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_13_1
Dialogue.English: Only now do I understand it.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_14_0
Dialogue.Text: Patrz, jak ten czas szybko leci.
Dialogue.English: Look how fast time flies.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_14_1
Dialogue.English: Every day is different.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_15_0
Dialogue.English: It's not my fault.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_15_1
Dialogue.English: Who did this?

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_16_0
Dialogue.English: I don't really like new things.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_16_1
Dialogue.English: I'm not old at all!

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_17_0
Dialogue.English: Lately it's hard for me to walk.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_17_1
Dialogue.English: But I have a right to my coffee!

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_18_0
Dialogue.Text: Mam dwie córki i jednego syna.
Dialogue.English: I have two daughters and one son.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_18_1
Dialogue.English: My family lives outside the town.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_18_2
Dialogue.English: I rarely talk to them.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_19_0
Dialogue.English: I have no family here.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_19_1
Dialogue.English: But I have my place here.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_20_0
Dialogue.Text: W tym miejscu był kiedyś sklep.
Dialogue.English: There used to be a shop on this spot.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_20_1
Dialogue.Text: Stolik, przy którym siedzę, jest mój.
Dialogue.English: The table I sit at is mine.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_20_2
Dialogue.English: Everyone sits at their own table.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_21_0
Dialogue.Text: To jest człowiek, którego znam od lat.
Dialogue.English: That's a man I've known for years.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_21_1
Dialogue.English: With a waiter like that, it's a pleasure.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_22_0
Dialogue.English: Michał should have his own place.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_22_1
Dialogue.English: Still, I like this café.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_23_0
Dialogue.Text: Gdybym wiedział wtedy to, co wiem teraz!
Dialogue.English: If only I'd known then what I know now!

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_24_0
Dialogue.Text: Będę tu siedział, dopóki nie zamkną.
Dialogue.English: I'll sit here until they close.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_24_1
Dialogue.English: That's my business.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_25_0
Dialogue.Text: Pamiętam ten park, kiedy był mały.
Dialogue.English: I remember this park when it was small.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_25_1
Dialogue.English: We were young once.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_26_0
Dialogue.English: At my age you have to rest.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_26_1
Dialogue.Text: Mężczyzna powinien pić kawę bez cukru.
Dialogue.English: A man should drink coffee without sugar.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_27_0
Dialogue.English: I lost my wife many years ago.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_27_1
Dialogue.English: There are no people like that any more.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_28_0
Dialogue.Text: Czytam gazetę od początku do końca.
Dialogue.English: I read the paper from beginning to end.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_28_1
Dialogue.Text: Kawa oraz gazeta: to moje śniadanie.
Dialogue.English: Coffee and the paper: that's my breakfast.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_29_0
Dialogue.English: I built a house with these hands.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_29_1
Dialogue.English: I have a good head for numbers.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_30_0
Dialogue.Text: Syn ma swojego psa, a ja swoją gazetę.
Dialogue.English: My son has his dog, and I have my paper.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_30_1
Dialogue.Text: W portfelu mam zdjęcia swoich wnuków.
Dialogue.English: I have photos of my grandchildren in my wallet.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_31_0
Dialogue.Text: Moje dzieci mieszkają w innym mieście.
Dialogue.English: My children live in another town.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_31_1
Dialogue.Text: Ludzi, których znam, jest coraz mniej.
Dialogue.English: There are fewer and fewer people I know.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_32_0
Dialogue.Text: Policja stoi przy ratuszu. Ciekawe, dlaczego.
Dialogue.English: The police are standing by the town hall. I wonder why.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_32_1
Dialogue.Text: W gazecie piszą dużo o policji.
Dialogue.English: The paper writes a lot about the police.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_33_0
Dialogue.English: I can't sit any longer. My back!

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_33_1
Dialogue.Text: Ciało jest stare, ale głowa młoda.
Dialogue.English: The body is old, but the head is young.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_33_2
Dialogue.Text: Spacer jest dobry dla ciała i dla głowy.
Dialogue.English: A walk is good for body and mind.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_34_0
Dialogue.English: Michał is a good lad.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_34_1
Dialogue.Text: Złego słowa o nim nie powiem.
Dialogue.English: I won't say a bad word about him.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_34_2
Dialogue.English: Michał is a good person.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_35_0
Dialogue.Text: Złe wiadomości w gazecie, jak zawsze.
Dialogue.English: Bad news in the paper, as always.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_35_1
Dialogue.Text: To artykuł o człowieku z naszego miasta.
Dialogue.English: It's an article about a man from our town.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_36_0
Dialogue.Text: Nasza gazeta istnieje od stu lat.
Dialogue.English: Our paper has existed for a hundred years.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_36_1
Dialogue.English: I like books about history.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_37_0
Dialogue.Text: Nowym ludziom zawsze mówię dzień dobry.
Dialogue.English: I always say good morning to new people.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_37_1
Dialogue.Text: Siedzę zawsze przy tym samym stoliku.
Dialogue.English: I always sit at the same table.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_38_0
Dialogue.English: I know my rights!

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_39_0
Dialogue.Text: W latach sześćdziesiątych tu był sklep.
Dialogue.English: In the sixties there was a shop here.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_39_1
Dialogue.Text: Przyszedłem tu pierwszy raz jako dziecko.
Dialogue.English: I first came here as a child.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_40_0
Dialogue.English: Remember: think first, then speak.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_41_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój syn mieszka w budynku obok banku.
Dialogue.English: My son lives in the building next to the bank.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_42_0
Dialogue.English: I once wanted to have a ship.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_42_1
Dialogue.English: I like talking about the past.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_43_0
Dialogue.English: Everything has changed.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_43_1
Dialogue.English: This view is beautiful.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_43_2
Dialogue.English: It's a fact.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_44_0
Dialogue.Text: Mówili mi, że jestem za stary na kawę.
Dialogue.English: They told me I'm too old for coffee.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_44_1
Dialogue.Text: Kiedyś było lepiej. A może gorzej?
Dialogue.English: It used to be better. Or maybe worse?

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_45_0
Dialogue.Text: W imieniu wszystkich gości dziękuję, Michał!
Dialogue.English: On behalf of all the guests, thank you, Michał!

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_45_1
Dialogue.English: Michał is the best waiter.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_46_0
Dialogue.English: I always told my father the truth.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_46_1
Dialogue.English: My father lived to ninety.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_47_0
Dialogue.English: The state, the government, the president... the same old problems.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_47_1
Dialogue.Text: Nie rozmawiam z nikim o polityce.
Dialogue.English: I don't talk to anyone about politics.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_48_0
Dialogue.Text: Raport w gazecie mówi, że będzie gorąco.
Dialogue.English: A report in the paper says it'll be hot.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_48_1
Dialogue.English: It'll probably rain.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_49_0
Dialogue.Text: Podróż autobusem? Nie, wolę iść pieszo.
Dialogue.English: A trip by bus? No, I prefer to walk.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_50_0
Dialogue.Text: Zostałem sam, ale nie jestem smutny.
Dialogue.English: I've been left alone, but I'm not sad.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_50_1
Dialogue.English: I only ever loved one woman.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_51_0
Dialogue.Text: Z moimi przyjaciółmi graliśmy w karty.
Dialogue.English: My friends and I used to play cards.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_51_1
Dialogue.English: They write all sorts of things in the paper.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_52_0
Dialogue.English: Step by step, slowly.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_52_1
Dialogue.English: Some people don't read the papers.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_52_2
Dialogue.English: Not many people read papers today.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_53_0
Dialogue.English: That's what young people are like.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_53_1
Dialogue.English: I play chess with my brother.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_54_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój dom jest daleko, a stamtąd widać góry.
Dialogue.English: My house is far away, and you can see the mountains from there.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_55_0
Dialogue.English: That makes no sense.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_55_1
Dialogue.English: The meaning of life? Coffee!

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_55_2
Dialogue.English: It doesn't matter.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_56_0
Dialogue.English: What's the difference?

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_56_1
Dialogue.Text: Jedyny problem: kawa jest za słaba.
Dialogue.English: The only problem: the coffee's too weak.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_57_0
Dialogue.Text: Gazeta w rękach, kawa na stole.
Dialogue.English: The paper in my hands, coffee on the table.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_57_1
Dialogue.English: This park reminds me of my childhood.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_58_0
Dialogue.Text: Dobrych ludzi jest więcej niż złych.
Dialogue.English: There are more good people than bad.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_58_1
Dialogue.English: My brother lost his job.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_59_0
Dialogue.English: I used to write letters to my wife.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_59_1
Dialogue.English: I'm a little tired.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_60_0
Dialogue.Text: Za moich czasów ludzie znacznie więcej czytali.
Dialogue.English: In my day people read much more.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_60_1
Dialogue.Text: Mój ojciec znał każdego w mieście.
Dialogue.English: My father knew everyone in town.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_61_0
Dialogue.English: Nobody listens to an old man.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_61_1
Dialogue.English: I have my father's old watch.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_62_0
Dialogue.Text: W czasach mojej młodości nie było telefonów.
Dialogue.English: When I was young there were no phones.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_62_1
Dialogue.English: I was a small boy then.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_63_0
Dialogue.English: I used to go to church every Sunday.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_64_0
Dialogue.English: This article is about our park.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_64_1
Dialogue.Text: Moim zdaniem kawa była kiedyś lepsza.
Dialogue.English: In my opinion coffee used to be better.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_65_0
Dialogue.English: Previously there was a different waiter here.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_65_1
Dialogue.English: I remember that waiter.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_66_0
Dialogue.English: Experience is the best teacher.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_66_1
Dialogue.English: Nothing lasts for ever.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_67_0
Dialogue.English: Hundreds of people used to come here.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_67_1
Dialogue.English: A lot went on here.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_68_0
Dialogue.English: The queen once came to Poland.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_68_1
Dialogue.English: I saw the queen on TV.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_69_0
Dialogue.English: I'm grateful for every day.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_69_1
Dialogue.English: People leave rubbish in the park.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_70_0
Dialogue.Text: W moim wieku wszystko to ryzyko.
Dialogue.English: At my age everything's a risk.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_70_1
Dialogue.Text: Wydawało mi się, że widziałem Józefa.
Dialogue.English: I thought I saw Józef.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_71_0
Dialogue.Text: Moi dwaj synowie mieszkają za granicą.
Dialogue.English: My two sons live abroad.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_71_1
Dialogue.English: On important matters I ask my son.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_72_0
Dialogue.English: Last winter it was very cold.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_73_0
Dialogue.English: Professor! That's what they used to call me.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_73_1
Dialogue.English: Few people remember those times.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_74_0
Dialogue.Text: Ten kamień przy fontannie jest stary jak ja.
Dialogue.English: That stone by the fountain is as old as me.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_74_1
Dialogue.English: A world without newspapers? Not good.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_75_0
Dialogue.Text: Moja żona odeszła dziesięć lat temu.
Dialogue.English: My wife passed away ten years ago.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_75_1
Dialogue.English: My father loved this park.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_76_0
Dialogue.English: When I was young, I worked a lot.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_76_1
Dialogue.Text: Ludzie, z którymi pracowałem, już są na emeryturze.
Dialogue.English: The people I worked with are already retired.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_77_0
Dialogue.English: You have to learn how to be old.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_77_1
Dialogue.English: These are serious matters.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_78_0
Dialogue.English: Really?

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_78_1
Dialogue.English: In reality it's different.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_79_0
Dialogue.English: I thought it would be easy.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_79_1
Dialogue.English: It's been worse.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_80_0
Dialogue.Text: Ojciec trzymał mnie za rękę w tym parku.
Dialogue.English: My father held my hand in this park.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_80_1
Dialogue.English: I want to stay here.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_81_0
Dialogue.Text: Mając tyle lat, mogę mówić, co chcę.
Dialogue.English: At my age, I can say what I like.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_81_1
Dialogue.English: A man's word!

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_82_0
Dialogue.Text: Mogę ci opowiedzieć o tym parku.
Dialogue.English: I can tell you about this park.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_82_1
Dialogue.English: The park used to look different.

Dialogue.Name: zbigniew_chat_83_0
Dialogue.English: You can't buy freedom.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Hi! I'm Kasia.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_intro_0_1
Dialogue.Text: Pracuję tu, bo w domu jest za cicho.
Dialogue.English: I work here because it's too quiet at home.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_intro_0_2
Dialogue.Text: W moim pokoju nie mogę myśleć.
Dialogue.English: I can't think in my room.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_0_0
Dialogue.English: Hello? Yes, it's me.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_0_1
Dialogue.English: No, I can't talk now.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_1_0
Dialogue.English: I got a message from my boss.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_1_1
Dialogue.English: He wants me to come in earlier tomorrow.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_1_2
Dialogue.English: For what reason?

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_2_0
Dialogue.English: What's your number?

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_3_0
Dialogue.Text: Mam pytanie: czy ta kawa jest z mlekiem?
Dialogue.English: I have a question: does this coffee have milk in it?

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_3_1
Dialogue.English: What kind of coffee do you like?

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_4_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój plan na dziś: praca, kawa, praca.
Dialogue.English: My plan for today: work, coffee, work.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_4_1
Dialogue.English: I have important things to do today.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_5_0
Dialogue.English: I thought I'd finish earlier.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_5_1
Dialogue.Text: Chciałam iść do kina, ale nie mam czasu.
Dialogue.English: I wanted to go to the cinema, but I don't have time.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_6_0
Dialogue.English: I had a hard day yesterday.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_6_1
Dialogue.English: I worked all night.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_7_0
Dialogue.Text: Ten komputer w ogóle nie działa!
Dialogue.English: This computer doesn't work at all!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_7_1
Dialogue.English: That's odd. The same thing again!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_7_2
Dialogue.English: It can't be done!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_8_0
Dialogue.English: Sounds good!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_9_0
Dialogue.English: I'm glad to see you.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_9_1
Dialogue.English: You look good today!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_10_0
Dialogue.English: Nice to meet you.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_10_1
Dialogue.Text: Co u ciebie? Bo u mnie całkiem dobrze.
Dialogue.English: How are you? I'm doing pretty well.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_11_0
Dialogue.English: Can you smell that? Someone's baking bread.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_12_0
Dialogue.Text: Nie mam pojęcia, która jest godzina.
Dialogue.English: I have no idea what time it is.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_12_1
Dialogue.English: I've been working for two hours already.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_12_2
Dialogue.English: A few more minutes.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_13_0
Dialogue.English: I did it! I've finished!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_13_1
Dialogue.English: Friday at last!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_14_0
Dialogue.English: I'm not sure.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_14_1
Dialogue.Text: Zdaję sobie sprawę, że dużo pracuję.
Dialogue.English: I realise I work a lot.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_15_0
Dialogue.English: This job is like a game.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_15_1
Dialogue.English: The same thing every day.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_15_2
Dialogue.Text: Ale z każdym dniem jest lepiej.
Dialogue.English: But it gets better every day.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_16_0
Dialogue.Text: Mówią, że Michał chce mieć swój lokal.
Dialogue.English: They say Michał wants his own place.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_16_1
Dialogue.Text: Dziewczyna, o której mówię, to Ola.
Dialogue.English: The girl I'm talking about is Ola.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_17_0
Dialogue.English: I write texts. I'm looking for the right word.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_17_1
Dialogue.English: What does that mean in Polish?

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_18_0
Dialogue.English: Leave it, I'll do it.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_18_1
Dialogue.Text: Zrób mi przysługę i nic nie mów.
Dialogue.English: Do me a favour and don't say anything.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_19_0
Dialogue.English: I have to get back to work.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_19_1
Dialogue.Text: Jedna kawa to za mało. Każdy potrzebuje kawy.
Dialogue.English: One coffee isn't enough. Everyone needs coffee.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_20_0
Dialogue.English: Can I help you with something?

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_20_1
Dialogue.English: Where are you going?

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_20_2
Dialogue.English: Shall we go for ice cream?

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_21_0
Dialogue.Text: Kobiety w mojej pracy są super.
Dialogue.English: The women at my work are great.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_21_1
Dialogue.Text: Dziewczyny z pracy idą dziś do kina.
Dialogue.English: The girls from work are going to the cinema today.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_22_0
Dialogue.English: Lots of people work from home.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_22_1
Dialogue.Text: Dla innych to nic, dla mnie dużo.
Dialogue.English: For others it's nothing, for me it's a lot.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_23_0
Dialogue.English: My hands are cold.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_23_1
Dialogue.English: My eyes hurt from the computer.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_24_0
Dialogue.Text: Byłoby miło, gdybym miała więcej czasu.
Dialogue.English: It would be nice if I had more time.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_24_1
Dialogue.English: I'd happily go for a walk.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_25_0
Dialogue.English: My sister stayed at home.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_25_1
Dialogue.English: She couldn't come.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_25_2
Dialogue.Text: Mama powiedziała, że mam za dużo pracy.
Dialogue.English: Mum said I have too much work.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_26_0
Dialogue.English: I want to get a new job.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_26_1
Dialogue.English: I don't need anything else.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_27_0
Dialogue.English: This is the coffee I like.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_27_1
Dialogue.Text: Lubię twoją torbę. Czy to od twojego taty?
Dialogue.English: I like your bag. Is it from your dad?

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_28_0
Dialogue.English: I always have my computer with me.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_28_1
Dialogue.English: I'm off on Tuesday.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_29_0
Dialogue.Text: Powinniśmy kiedyś pójść razem na kawę.
Dialogue.English: We should go for a coffee together some time.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_30_0
Dialogue.English: I have to check my messages.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_30_1
Dialogue.English: My boss gave me a new project.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_31_0
Dialogue.English: I have a meeting in an hour.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_31_1
Dialogue.Text: Pracuję od kilku godzin bez przerwy.
Dialogue.English: I've been working for several hours without a break.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_32_0
Dialogue.English: I made a mistake in the text.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_32_1
Dialogue.English: Never mind. I have to start over.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_33_0
Dialogue.English: I've got loads of work.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_33_1
Dialogue.English: That's impossible!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_33_2
Dialogue.English: Only coffee will help me.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_34_0
Dialogue.English: That's right!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_34_1
Dialogue.English: I have the same problem again.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_35_0
Dialogue.English: I completely forgot about the meeting!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_36_0
Dialogue.English: Can you hear? Someone's playing the guitar.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_37_0
Dialogue.Text: Na przykład: kawa z mlekiem albo bez.
Dialogue.English: For example: coffee with milk or without.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_37_1
Dialogue.English: I like tea too.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_38_0
Dialogue.English: A message from Mum: she'll be back this evening.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_39_0
Dialogue.English: As long as I have coffee, I can work.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_39_1
Dialogue.English: I intend to finish it today.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_40_0
Dialogue.English: I think it's a good idea.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_40_1
Dialogue.English: And you, what do you think?

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_40_2
Dialogue.English: Do you think I'll make it?

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_41_0
Dialogue.English: Lack of time is my problem.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_41_1
Dialogue.English: I'll deal with it tomorrow.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_41_2
Dialogue.English: I'll have one more coffee.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_42_0
Dialogue.English: I'll finish within an hour.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_42_1
Dialogue.English: Supposedly I'm off, but I'm working.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_43_0
Dialogue.Text: Pewnego dnia będę mieć swoją firmę.
Dialogue.English: One day I'll have my own company.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_43_1
Dialogue.English: New job, new life!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_44_0
Dialogue.English: I have everything on one computer.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_44_1
Dialogue.English: Don't worry about anything.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_45_0
Dialogue.English: I need your advice.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_45_1
Dialogue.Text: Znasz tego faceta z gazetą? To pan Zbigniew.
Dialogue.English: Do you know that guy with the newspaper? That's Mr Zbigniew.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_46_0
Dialogue.English: I don't like going to the office.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_46_1
Dialogue.English: I'm looking for information about the new project.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_47_0
Dialogue.English: I have all the information on my computer.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_47_1
Dialogue.English: I have to send a letter to the company.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_48_0
Dialogue.English: Call me later!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_48_1
Dialogue.English: What's your address?

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_49_0
Dialogue.Text: Moja grupa w pracy jest bardzo dobra.
Dialogue.English: My group at work is very good.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_49_1
Dialogue.Text: Mamy dziś dwie rozmowy z klientami.
Dialogue.English: We have two talks with clients today.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_49_2
Dialogue.English: I have a talk with my boss tomorrow.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_50_0
Dialogue.English: I'm afraid I won't make it.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_50_1
Dialogue.English: The last two weeks were awful.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_51_0
Dialogue.English: I've been working here for five weeks.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_51_1
Dialogue.English: All in all, I like my job.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_52_0
Dialogue.English: Basically, I've finished.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_52_1
Dialogue.Text: Nie mam pojęcia, jak to wyjaśnić.
Dialogue.English: I have no idea how to explain it.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_53_0
Dialogue.English: I need a better computer.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_53_1
Dialogue.English: This one is better, but expensive.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_54_0
Dialogue.English: Of course!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_54_1
Dialogue.English: Check your messages!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_54_2
Dialogue.English: I'll check it.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_55_0
Dialogue.English: I'm interested in health and sport.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_55_1
Dialogue.Text: Mój cel na ten rok: mniej pracy.
Dialogue.English: My goal for this year: less work.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_56_0
Dialogue.English: I feel strange without coffee.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_56_1
Dialogue.English: Indeed, it's good coffee.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_57_0
Dialogue.Text: Zaczynam o dziewiątej, kończę o piątej.
Dialogue.English: I start at nine and finish at five.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_57_1
Dialogue.English: I leave at five.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_58_0
Dialogue.English: It was a joke!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_58_1
Dialogue.Text: Komu to wysłać? Szefowi czy całej grupie?
Dialogue.English: Who should I send it to? My boss or the whole group?

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_59_0
Dialogue.English: Do you work somewhere?

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_59_1
Dialogue.English: I'll see if I have time.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_60_0
Dialogue.English: I have no choice.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_60_1
Dialogue.English: I worked on it for three months.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_60_2
Dialogue.English: I finished at the last moment!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_61_0
Dialogue.English: What kind of coffee do you like?

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_61_1
Dialogue.English: Great coffee!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_62_0
Dialogue.English: I work with other people.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_62_1
Dialogue.English: I want my own company.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_63_0
Dialogue.English: At the moment I'm busy.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_63_1
Dialogue.English: This'll take a moment.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_64_0
Dialogue.English: That won't change anything.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_64_1
Dialogue.English: I have a to-do list.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_65_0
Dialogue.English: I'm searching for words.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_65_1
Dialogue.English: I usually drink two coffees.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_65_2
Dialogue.English: I'm drinking my last coffee for today.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_66_0
Dialogue.English: I'll manage.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_66_1
Dialogue.Text: Z innej strony, jutro mam wolne.
Dialogue.English: On the other hand, I'm off tomorrow.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_67_0
Dialogue.English: There are big changes at work.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_67_1
Dialogue.Text: W nowej pracy wszystko będzie inaczej.
Dialogue.English: In the new job everything will be different.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_67_2
Dialogue.English: The new system is awful.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_68_0
Dialogue.English: I have three meetings today.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_68_1
Dialogue.English: Someone's calling again!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_69_0
Dialogue.Text: W tej sytuacji nic nie zrobię.
Dialogue.English: In this situation I can't do anything.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_69_1
Dialogue.Text: Wszystko, co potrzebne, mam w torbie.
Dialogue.English: Everything I need is in my bag.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_70_0
Dialogue.English: I have to send the documents to my boss.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_70_1
Dialogue.English: My boss sent me a message.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_71_0
Dialogue.Text: Kod do drzwi? Zero, zero, siedem.
Dialogue.English: The door code? Zero, zero, seven.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_72_0
Dialogue.English: This process is too long.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_72_1
Dialogue.English: It takes a lot of work.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_73_0
Dialogue.English: Control everything? It can't be done.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_73_1
Dialogue.English: We'll start the project on Monday.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_74_0
Dialogue.English: It turned out better than I thought.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_74_1
Dialogue.English: My boss changed the plan.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_74_2
Dialogue.English: There's no other plan.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_75_0
Dialogue.English: Business isn't everything.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_75_1
Dialogue.Text: Szukają nowych ludzi w mojej firmie.
Dialogue.English: They're looking for new people at my company.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_76_0
Dialogue.English: I need peace and quiet to concentrate.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_76_1
Dialogue.Text: Muszę to skończyć do końca tygodnia.
Dialogue.English: I have to finish this by the end of the week.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_77_0
Dialogue.Text: Pracuję głównie w domu albo tu.
Dialogue.English: I work mainly at home or here.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_77_1
Dialogue.English: Do you live around here?

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_78_0
Dialogue.Text: Patrzysz na mój komputer? Nic ciekawego.
Dialogue.English: Looking at my computer? Nothing interesting.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_78_1
Dialogue.English: Interesting! Tell me more.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_79_0
Dialogue.Text: Sukces to dużo pracy i trochę szczęścia.
Dialogue.English: Success is a lot of work and a bit of luck.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_79_1
Dialogue.English: More time would come in handy.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_80_0
Dialogue.English: I assume the boss knows.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_80_1
Dialogue.English: I'll send you the details later.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_81_0
Dialogue.English: I practically live in this café.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_81_1
Dialogue.English: I came early on purpose.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_82_0
Dialogue.English: It was a mistake.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_82_1
Dialogue.English: Officially, I'm off today.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_83_0
Dialogue.English: At the moment I'm working on a new website.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_83_1
Dialogue.English: The solution is simple.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_84_0
Dialogue.Text: Kurs angielskiego zaczyna się w październiku.
Dialogue.English: The English course starts in October.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_85_0
Dialogue.English: I work on my own computer.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_85_1
Dialogue.English: I drink coffee while I work.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_86_0
Dialogue.Text: Z tym problemem nic nie zrobię.
Dialogue.English: I can't do anything about this problem.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_86_1
Dialogue.English: I understand your situation.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_87_0
Dialogue.Text: W pewnym momencie komputer przestał działać.
Dialogue.English: At one point the computer stopped working.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_87_1
Dialogue.English: It's a matter of time.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_88_0
Dialogue.Text: Z wielu powodów lubię tę pracę.
Dialogue.English: I like this job for many reasons.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_88_1
Dialogue.English: My job is about writing.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_89_0
Dialogue.English: I have a recording of the meeting.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_89_1
Dialogue.English: My boss writes to me every day.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_90_0
Dialogue.English: I've got no signal!

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_90_1
Dialogue.English: It's complicated.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_90_2
Dialogue.English: In a way, yes.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_91_0
Dialogue.Text: W tym miesiącu mam dużo pracy.
Dialogue.English: I have a lot of work this month.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_91_1
Dialogue.English: I'll pay by card.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_92_0
Dialogue.English: Everyone uses a phone.

Dialogue.Name: kasia_chat_92_1
Dialogue.English: My boss thinks I'll make it.

Dialogue.Name: roman_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Good morning! My name is Roman.

Dialogue.Name: roman_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I'm a bus driver.

Dialogue.Name: roman_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: I've got half an hour's break now.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Autobus jedzie prosto do centrum miasta.
Dialogue.English: The bus goes straight to the town centre.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_0_1
Dialogue.English: And then back again.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_1_0
Dialogue.English: I've been driving here for over twenty years.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_1_1
Dialogue.Text: Nie jest łatwo, ale lubię to.
Dialogue.English: It isn't easy, but I like it.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_2_0
Dialogue.Text: Według rozkładu autobus jest za pięć minut.
Dialogue.English: According to the timetable, the bus is in five minutes.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_2_1
Dialogue.English: But it'll probably be late.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_3_0
Dialogue.English: There was an accident on the road.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_3_1
Dialogue.Text: Nic się nie stało, na szczęście.
Dialogue.English: Nobody was hurt, luckily.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_4_0
Dialogue.English: I work six days a week.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_4_1
Dialogue.English: Sometimes even seven!

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_5_0
Dialogue.Text: Pierwsze autobusy jeżdżą o piątej rano.
Dialogue.English: The first buses run at five in the morning.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_5_1
Dialogue.English: The last bus is at midnight.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_6_0
Dialogue.English: Soon I'll be retired.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_6_1
Dialogue.English: Before long, before long.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_7_0
Dialogue.Text: Ludzie chcą jechać szybciej, ale ja jadę spokojnie.
Dialogue.English: People want to go faster, but I drive calmly.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_8_0
Dialogue.English: My house is close to the stop.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_9_0
Dialogue.English: I've been a driver all over the country.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_9_1
Dialogue.English: I've seen half the world!

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_10_0
Dialogue.English: I like driving in the morning best.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_10_1
Dialogue.English: In the evening there are too many cars.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_11_0
Dialogue.English: I have a week off in August.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_12_0
Dialogue.Text: Około dziesięciu osób jeździ ze mną codziennie.
Dialogue.English: About ten people ride with me every day.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_12_1
Dialogue.English: I know them all.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_13_0
Dialogue.English: Careful, the bus is coming!

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_14_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój syn też chce być kierowcą.
Dialogue.English: My son wants to be a driver too.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_14_1
Dialogue.Text: Mówię mu: to nie jest łatwa praca.
Dialogue.English: I tell him: it's not an easy job.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_15_0
Dialogue.Text: Muszę zatrzymać autobus na każdym przystanku.
Dialogue.English: I have to stop the bus at every stop.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_15_1
Dialogue.English: You have to buy a ticket before the ride.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_16_0
Dialogue.Text: Kiedykolwiek chcesz, możesz jechać ze mną.
Dialogue.English: Whenever you like, you can ride with me.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_17_0
Dialogue.Text: Nie obchodzi mnie pogoda. Jeżdżę zawsze.
Dialogue.English: I don't care about the weather. I always drive.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_17_1
Dialogue.Text: To zależy od dnia, ile jest ludzi.
Dialogue.English: How many people there are depends on the day.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_18_0
Dialogue.English: I completely forgot what time it is!

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_19_0
Dialogue.English: We used to have an old bus.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_19_1
Dialogue.English: It was huge and loud.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_20_0
Dialogue.Text: Część ludzi wysiada tutaj, a część jedzie dalej.
Dialogue.English: Some people get off here, and some go on.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_21_0
Dialogue.English: Though I'm tired, I'm happy.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_21_1
Dialogue.English: I'd like to rest, but I can't.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_22_0
Dialogue.English: I have to get back now. See you!

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_23_0
Dialogue.English: Let's keep going!

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_23_1
Dialogue.English: People shout: get going!

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_24_0
Dialogue.Text: Za pierwszym razem od razu wiedziałem: to praca dla mnie.
Dialogue.English: The first time, I knew straight away: this job is for me.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_25_0
Dialogue.English: I found a phone on the bus.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_25_1
Dialogue.English: Once we found a dog on the bus!

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_25_2
Dialogue.English: If you lose something, we'll find it.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_26_0
Dialogue.English: I have a holiday in a few months.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_26_1
Dialogue.Text: Autobus jest wystarczająco duży dla wszystkich.
Dialogue.English: The bus is big enough for everyone.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_27_0
Dialogue.English: I know the road by heart.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_27_1
Dialogue.English: The last buses are empty.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_28_0
Dialogue.English: Wait a moment, the next one's coming soon.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_28_1
Dialogue.English: It shouldn't take long.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_29_0
Dialogue.English: Children, you have to sit down!

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_30_0
Dialogue.English: They're doing roadworks.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_30_1
Dialogue.English: Three drivers are off sick today.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_31_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój syn i córka wiedzą, że tata dużo pracuje.
Dialogue.English: My son and daughter know their dad works a lot.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_31_1
Dialogue.English: I don't have a car. What for?

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_32_0
Dialogue.English: Could someone help me?

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_32_1
Dialogue.English: Who will be the driver after me?

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_33_0
Dialogue.English: There are five minutes left until we leave.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_33_1
Dialogue.Text: Nie mam żadnego problemu z ludźmi.
Dialogue.English: I don't have any problem with people.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_34_0
Dialogue.English: Which bus are you taking?

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_35_0
Dialogue.English: Next time you'll ride with me.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_35_1
Dialogue.English: Good luck!

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_36_0
Dialogue.Text: Na tej ulicy jest dużo ruchu.
Dialogue.English: There's a lot of traffic on this street.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_36_1
Dialogue.English: Drive slower! I tell the drivers.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_37_0
Dialogue.English: Stop the bus! someone shouts.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_37_1
Dialogue.English: The bus stops here.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_38_0
Dialogue.English: Line two goes through the centre.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_38_1
Dialogue.English: This road leads to the centre.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_39_0
Dialogue.English: Since the accident I drive carefully.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_40_0
Dialogue.English: In the car I listen to the radio.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_40_1
Dialogue.English: The stop is a hundred metres from here.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_41_0
Dialogue.English: Which way are you going?

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_41_1
Dialogue.English: Good sleep is the key.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_42_0
Dialogue.English: The bus comes back at six.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_42_1
Dialogue.Text: Mówimy po polsku, ale ludzie są z całego świata.
Dialogue.English: We speak Polish, but people come from all over the world.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_43_0
Dialogue.Text: Każdy pasażer liczy się dla mnie.
Dialogue.English: Every passenger counts for me.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_43_1
Dialogue.English: My colleague called. He's ill.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_44_0
Dialogue.Text: Wyjście jest z przodu i z tyłu.
Dialogue.English: The exit is at the front and the back.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_44_1
Dialogue.English: There's no way out, you have to wait.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_45_0
Dialogue.English: I'm taking my holiday in August.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_45_1
Dialogue.English: Time for coffee!

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_45_2
Dialogue.English: Just round the corner there's a bakery.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_46_0
Dialogue.English: Red light! Stop.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_46_1
Dialogue.English: It's going to start raining any minute.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_47_0
Dialogue.English: I do my job.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_47_1
Dialogue.English: We'll get there on time.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_48_0
Dialogue.English: This is the last break today.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_48_1
Dialogue.English: Two minutes and we're off!

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_49_0
Dialogue.English: Someone left an umbrella on the bus.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_49_1
Dialogue.English: People should have tickets.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_50_0
Dialogue.English: You have to take life easy.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_50_1
Dialogue.Text: To nie przypadek, że tu pracuję.
Dialogue.English: It's no accident that I work here.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_51_0
Dialogue.English: Here comes the bus, just in time!

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_51_1
Dialogue.English: No wonder there's a traffic jam.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_52_0
Dialogue.English: People come from far away.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_52_1
Dialogue.English: The next day I drive again.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_53_0
Dialogue.English: Eight o'clock sharp, we go.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_53_1
Dialogue.Text: W każdym przypadku jestem na czas.
Dialogue.English: I'm on time in every case.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_54_0
Dialogue.English: Get on, we're off!

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_54_1
Dialogue.English: I've driven this road for years.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_55_0
Dialogue.English: Four passengers are waiting at the stop.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_55_1
Dialogue.English: They're waiting for me.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_56_0
Dialogue.English: We go back to the depot at midnight.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_56_1
Dialogue.English: We set off in a minute.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_57_0
Dialogue.English: We'll get there safely.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_57_1
Dialogue.English: The bus is safe.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_58_0
Dialogue.Text: Lot? Nigdy w życiu. Wolę autobus.
Dialogue.English: A flight? Never in my life. I prefer the bus.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_58_1
Dialogue.Text: Z samolotu wszystko jest małe, mówi syn.
Dialogue.English: From a plane everything looks small, my son says.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_59_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój wóz jest stary, ale dobry.
Dialogue.English: My vehicle's old, but good.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_59_1
Dialogue.Text: Patrzę na drogę jednym okiem, a na ludzi drugim.
Dialogue.English: I watch the road with one eye and the people with the other.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_60_0
Dialogue.Text: Po lewej stronie jest szkoła, po prawej park.
Dialogue.English: On the left is the school, on the right the park.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_60_1
Dialogue.English: The stop is next to the park.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_61_0
Dialogue.English: Winter's coming.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_61_1
Dialogue.English: The holiday season is a lot of work.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_62_0
Dialogue.English: If you'll let me, I'll tell you a story.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_63_0
Dialogue.English: A couple of passengers forgot their tickets.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_63_1
Dialogue.Text: Rozkład jazdy zmienia się w wakacje.
Dialogue.English: The timetable changes in the holidays.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_64_0
Dialogue.English: Every driver gets a break.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_64_1
Dialogue.English: We can't turn back time.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_65_0
Dialogue.English: Sooner or later the bus will come.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_65_1
Dialogue.English: It takes an hour to go round the town.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_66_0
Dialogue.English: We have to get there on time.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_66_1
Dialogue.English: There's a good connection to the centre.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_67_0
Dialogue.English: To the last stop!

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_67_1
Dialogue.English: There are traffic jams in lots of places.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_68_0
Dialogue.English: I came back from holiday yesterday.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_68_1
Dialogue.English: People always find a seat.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_69_0
Dialogue.English: I only drive a car on Sundays.

Dialogue.Name: roman_chat_69_1
Dialogue.English: We'll wait one more minute.

Dialogue.Name: ela_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Good morning! I'm Ela.

Dialogue.Name: ela_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I can't find my ticket!

Dialogue.Name: ela_intro_0_2
Dialogue.Text: Chyba zgubiłam go w parku, na ścieżce.
Dialogue.English: I think I lost it in the park, on the path.

Dialogue.Name: ela_intro_0_3
Dialogue.Text: Mam ważne spotkanie za pół godziny.
Dialogue.English: I have an important meeting in half an hour.

Dialogue.Name: ela_done_0_0
Dialogue.English: My ticket! Thank you!

Dialogue.Name: ela_done_0_1
Dialogue.English: Now I'm ready.

Dialogue.Name: ela_remind_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój bilet jest chyba w parku, na ścieżce.
Dialogue.English: My ticket is probably in the park, on the path.

Dialogue.Name: ela_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: No, that's not it.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_0_0
Dialogue.English: Hello? Yes, boss, I'm on my way!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_1_0
Dialogue.English: I saw that film yesterday.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_1_1
Dialogue.English: It was great!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_2_0
Dialogue.English: I should have left earlier.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_2_1
Dialogue.English: I told my husband I'd be late.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_3_0
Dialogue.English: I knew it would be like this!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_4_0
Dialogue.English: I made the children breakfast and left.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_5_0
Dialogue.Text: Chciałabym mieć samochód, ale nie mam.
Dialogue.English: I'd like to have a car, but I don't.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_6_0
Dialogue.English: Bye, darling! See you this evening!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_6_1
Dialogue.English: That was my son.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_7_0
Dialogue.English: I have a lot on my mind.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_8_0
Dialogue.Text: Moja córka chciała iść ze mną.
Dialogue.English: My daughter wanted to come with me.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_8_1
Dialogue.English: But she had to go to school.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_9_0
Dialogue.English: This bus is always full.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_9_1
Dialogue.English: Most people are going to work.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_10_0
Dialogue.English: At work I've got nothing but problems.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_10_1
Dialogue.English: But it'll be all right somehow.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_11_0
Dialogue.Text: Nie chcę o tym myśleć. Zmieńmy temat.
Dialogue.English: I don't want to think about it. Let's change the subject.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_11_1
Dialogue.English: That's funny, isn't it?

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_12_0
Dialogue.English: I have to go to the doctor.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_12_1
Dialogue.English: I've got a headache.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_13_0
Dialogue.English: I told my boss the truth.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_13_1
Dialogue.Text: Nie mogę uwierzyć, że już piątek!
Dialogue.English: I can't believe it's Friday already!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_14_0
Dialogue.English: I'm afraid I won't make it in time.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_14_1
Dialogue.Text: Ile to trwa? Mniej więcej pół godziny.
Dialogue.English: How long does it take? About half an hour.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_15_0
Dialogue.English: I have to phone my boss right now.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_16_0
Dialogue.English: My daughter made me a sandwich.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_16_1
Dialogue.English: You can't leave a child on their own.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_17_0
Dialogue.English: I have to buy some coffee.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_17_1
Dialogue.English: Some lady was asking about the bus.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_18_0
Dialogue.English: I want to be someone in life.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_18_1
Dialogue.Text: Jednej rzeczy nie rozumiem: dlaczego zawsze pada w poniedziałek?
Dialogue.English: One thing I don't understand: why does it always rain on Mondays?

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_19_0
Dialogue.English: Let me make a call.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_19_1
Dialogue.Text: Szef nie chce mi pozwolić pracować w domu.
Dialogue.English: My boss won't let me work from home.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_20_0
Dialogue.English: You can do it! I tell myself.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_20_1
Dialogue.English: Gosh, it's late!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_21_0
Dialogue.Text: Zwróć uwagę na rozkład, czasem się zmienia.
Dialogue.English: Pay attention to the timetable, it sometimes changes.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_21_1
Dialogue.Text: Sami nie wiedzą, kiedy przyjdzie autobus.
Dialogue.English: Even they don't know when the bus will come.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_22_0
Dialogue.Text: Powie mi ktoś, która jest godzina?
Dialogue.English: Will someone tell me what time it is?

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_22_1
Dialogue.Text: Co powiesz na kawę po pracy?
Dialogue.English: How about a coffee after work?

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_23_0
Dialogue.English: I like your friends from the park.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_23_1
Dialogue.Text: Babcia naszych dzieci mieszka tu blisko.
Dialogue.English: Our children's grandma lives close by.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_23_2
Dialogue.English: Everyone likes our daughter.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_24_0
Dialogue.Text: Panie doktorze, boli mnie głowa, powiem mu.
Dialogue.English: Doctor, I've got a headache, I'll tell him.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_24_1
Dialogue.Text: Pani doktor mówi, że muszę odpoczywać.
Dialogue.English: The doctor says I need to rest.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_25_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój syn czuje się dziś źle.
Dialogue.English: My son isn't feeling well today.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_25_1
Dialogue.Text: Nie mam żadnej przerwy w pracy.
Dialogue.English: I don't get any break at work.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_25_2
Dialogue.English: Do you need help?

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_26_0
Dialogue.English: Thank God, I have my ticket.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_27_0
Dialogue.English: My husband tells me: you were right.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_27_1
Dialogue.English: That's rare!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_28_0
Dialogue.English: My son asks: did you make me a sandwich?

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_28_1
Dialogue.Text: Córka mówi: mówiłaś, że wrócisz wcześniej!
Dialogue.English: My daughter says: you said you'd be back earlier!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_29_0
Dialogue.English: I could have taken a taxi.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_29_1
Dialogue.English: I have to catch the bus!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_30_0
Dialogue.Text: Jestem kobietą, która nie ma czasu.
Dialogue.English: I'm a woman with no time.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_30_1
Dialogue.English: I'll find time for a coffee. Maybe.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_31_0
Dialogue.Text: Po pracy jadę do szpitala, do mamy.
Dialogue.English: After work I'm going to the hospital, to see Mum.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_31_1
Dialogue.English: I'm worried about Mum.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_31_2
Dialogue.English: I bought Mum some flowers.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_32_0
Dialogue.English: My headache's gone.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_32_1
Dialogue.Text: Minęło pięć minut, a autobusu nie ma.
Dialogue.English: Five minutes have gone by and there's no bus.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_33_0
Dialogue.English: I have two children.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_33_1
Dialogue.Text: Z dziećmi nigdy nie jest nudno.
Dialogue.English: It's never boring with children.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_33_2
Dialogue.English: Children need a lot of love.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_34_0
Dialogue.Text: Mąż się martwi, kiedy się spóźniam.
Dialogue.English: My husband worries when I'm late.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_34_1
Dialogue.English: I love my mother.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_35_0
Dialogue.English: Enough! I've had enough of waiting!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_35_1
Dialogue.Text: Uwierz mi, to nie jest łatwe.
Dialogue.English: Believe me, it isn't easy.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_36_0
Dialogue.English: Do you believe in luck?

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_36_1
Dialogue.English: I enjoy life.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_37_0
Dialogue.English: I'll allow myself to sit down for a moment.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_37_1
Dialogue.English: I had to get up at five.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_38_0
Dialogue.English: When will it end?

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_38_1
Dialogue.English: I have to tell someone!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_39_0
Dialogue.Text: Weekend z rodziną to najlepsze, co jest.
Dialogue.English: A weekend with the family is the best thing there is.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_39_1
Dialogue.English: People think I have it easy.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_40_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój mąż wychodzi do pracy o siódmej.
Dialogue.English: My husband leaves for work at seven.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_40_1
Dialogue.English: The children are still in bed.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_41_0
Dialogue.English: My husband can find anything.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_41_1
Dialogue.English: My daughter found my phone.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_41_2
Dialogue.Text: Wczoraj znalazłam w torbie stary bilet.
Dialogue.English: Yesterday I found an old ticket in my bag.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_42_0
Dialogue.English: How do I look? All right?

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_42_1
Dialogue.English: Mum gave me this umbrella.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_43_0
Dialogue.English: The most important thing is family.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_43_1
Dialogue.English: Mum came back from the hospital.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_44_0
Dialogue.English: I want to thank you!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_44_1
Dialogue.English: The traffic jams are awful.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_45_0
Dialogue.English: No job is easy.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_45_1
Dialogue.English: There's no need to worry.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_45_2
Dialogue.English: You have to keep calm.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_46_0
Dialogue.English: Something must have happened.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_46_1
Dialogue.English: The journey to work takes an hour.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_47_0
Dialogue.Text: Moje dzieci chodzą na zajęcia z pływania.
Dialogue.English: My children go to swimming lessons.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_47_1
Dialogue.English: It'll take a bit longer.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_48_0
Dialogue.English: I'm barely alive!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_48_1
Dialogue.English: I've got no strength left.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_49_0
Dialogue.English: Are you taking an umbrella? my husband asks.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_49_1
Dialogue.English: Did you know about this? my husband asks.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_50_0
Dialogue.English: On Sunday I visit Dad.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_50_1
Dialogue.English: Dad and I always laugh.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_51_0
Dialogue.English: My daughter's afraid of dogs.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_51_1
Dialogue.English: I felt something was going to happen.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_52_0
Dialogue.English: A friend left me a message.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_52_1
Dialogue.English: I talked to my boss. It's fine.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_53_0
Dialogue.Text: Mieszkamy w mieszkaniu na czwartym piętrze.
Dialogue.English: We live in a flat on the fourth floor.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_53_1
Dialogue.Text: W sklepie obok domu jest wszystko.
Dialogue.English: The shop next to home has everything.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_54_0
Dialogue.English: I'm calling my husband.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_54_1
Dialogue.English: Call when you're home!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_55_0
Dialogue.Text: Mężczyźni nigdy nie słuchają, mówi moja mama.
Dialogue.English: Men never listen, my mum says.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_56_0
Dialogue.Text: Miały być dwa autobusy, a nie ma żadnego!
Dialogue.English: There were supposed to be two buses, and there isn't one!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_56_1
Dialogue.English: Half the people on the bus are asleep.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_57_0
Dialogue.Text: Jestem połowę dnia w pracy, połowę w domu.
Dialogue.English: I spend half the day at work and half at home.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_57_1
Dialogue.English: Done! That's everything for today.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_58_0
Dialogue.English: I like Mondays least.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_58_1
Dialogue.English: It's awfully cold today!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_59_0
Dialogue.English: Would you like a coffee? I ask my friend.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_59_1
Dialogue.Text: Przyszłaś! mówi szefowa, kiedy się spóźniam.
Dialogue.English: You came! my boss says when I'm late.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_60_0
Dialogue.Text: Dziewczyn w mojej pracy jest dużo.
Dialogue.English: There are lots of girls at my work.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_60_1
Dialogue.English: Ask Roman, he knows everything.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_61_0
Dialogue.English: Shall I drop in on you this evening?

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_61_1
Dialogue.English: I have to buy my son new trousers.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_62_0
Dialogue.Text: Przygotuj się, mówię sobie każdego ranka.
Dialogue.English: Get ready, I tell myself every morning.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_63_0
Dialogue.English: My boss called at six.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_63_1
Dialogue.English: My daughter finished school at one.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_64_0
Dialogue.English: It's better without a headache.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_64_1
Dialogue.English: I can't stand traffic jams.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_65_0
Dialogue.English: I made it by a miracle!

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_65_1
Dialogue.Text: Nic mi nie przyszło do głowy.
Dialogue.English: Nothing came to mind.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_66_0
Dialogue.English: This conversation is important.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_66_1
Dialogue.English: Work is hard.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_66_2
Dialogue.English: I'll talk to my boss.

Dialogue.Name: ela_chat_67_0
Dialogue.English: In films everything's easy.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_intro_0_0
Dialogue.English: Hey! I'm Bartek.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_intro_0_1
Dialogue.Text: Czekam na autobus. Jadę na trening.
Dialogue.English: I'm waiting for the bus. I'm going to training.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_intro_0_2
Dialogue.English: I play football.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Chłopaki z drużyny już są na boisku.
Dialogue.English: The guys from the team are already at the pitch.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_0_1
Dialogue.English: They'll have to wait for me!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_1_0
Dialogue.English: Seriously? Not bad!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_2_0
Dialogue.English: OK, OK, I get it.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_3_0
Dialogue.Text: Ten koleś z mojej szkoły jest najlepszy.
Dialogue.English: That guy from my school is the best.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_4_0
Dialogue.English: Look, I've got new boots!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_4_1
Dialogue.English: Huge, right?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_5_0
Dialogue.English: Show me your photos!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_5_1
Dialogue.English: This is my favourite photo.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_6_0
Dialogue.Text: W szkole mam kłopoty z matematyką.
Dialogue.English: At school I'm having trouble with maths.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_6_1
Dialogue.English: Shame I don't like counting.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_7_0
Dialogue.English: Forget about it!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_8_0
Dialogue.English: Go on, try it!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_8_1
Dialogue.English: It's easy.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_9_0
Dialogue.English: Tomorrow we're playing a match.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_9_1
Dialogue.English: I'm really excited!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_10_0
Dialogue.English: Dad says: son, school comes first.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_11_0
Dialogue.Text: Chłopcy z drużyny mówią, że jestem gotowy.
Dialogue.English: The boys on the team say I'm ready.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_11_1
Dialogue.English: I have lots of friends on the team.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_12_0
Dialogue.English: I'm waiting for my brother too.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_12_1
Dialogue.English: Wait, here it comes!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_13_0
Dialogue.English: What are we doing after training?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_13_1
Dialogue.English: Maybe we'll go for pizza?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_14_0
Dialogue.English: It's Mum's birthday today.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_14_1
Dialogue.English: I'll tell her: happy birthday!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_15_0
Dialogue.Text: Za dziesięć minut zaczyna się trening.
Dialogue.English: Training starts in ten minutes.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_16_0
Dialogue.English: I don't know how to do it.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_16_1
Dialogue.English: Maybe it'll work out somehow.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_17_0
Dialogue.English: They were supposed to win, but they lost.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_18_0
Dialogue.Text: Nikomu nie mów, ale lubię tańczyć.
Dialogue.English: Don't tell anyone, but I like dancing.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_19_0
Dialogue.Text: Dobranoc! A nie, jest rano. Cześć!
Dialogue.English: Good night! Oh no, it's morning. Bye!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_20_0
Dialogue.English: They could have played better.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_20_1
Dialogue.Text: Walczyć do końca! Tak mówi trener.
Dialogue.English: Fight to the end! That's what the coach says.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_21_0
Dialogue.English: Give me your hand!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_21_1
Dialogue.English: Ready? Go!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_22_0
Dialogue.English: The coach knows everyone in town.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_22_1
Dialogue.English: Has anyone seen my phone?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_23_0
Dialogue.English: I want to be a good footballer.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_23_1
Dialogue.English: We're playing against the best team.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_24_0
Dialogue.English: Which way does the bus go?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_24_1
Dialogue.English: Which side will it come from?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_25_0
Dialogue.Text: Z okazji urodzin mama dostanie kwiaty.
Dialogue.English: Mum's getting flowers for her birthday.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_25_1
Dialogue.English: I'm looking for a good film.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_26_0
Dialogue.English: Bro, come here!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_26_1
Dialogue.English: Not a bad match yesterday!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_26_2
Dialogue.English: Nice play!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_27_0
Dialogue.English: You've got decent shoes.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_27_1
Dialogue.English: My brother got a new phone.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_28_0
Dialogue.English: It started raining.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_28_1
Dialogue.English: The coach says: we play on!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_29_0
Dialogue.Text: Dziesięć sekund do końca, a ja strzelam gola!
Dialogue.English: Ten seconds to go, and I score a goal!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_30_0
Dialogue.English: I'm not a kid any more!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_30_1
Dialogue.Text: Dzieciaki z mojej szkoły są fajne.
Dialogue.English: The kids at my school are cool.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_31_0
Dialogue.Text: Nasi grają dziś mecz w telewizji!
Dialogue.English: Our team is playing on TV today!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_31_1
Dialogue.English: They wanted me in the first team!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_32_0
Dialogue.English: They had to wait for me.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_32_1
Dialogue.Text: Powiedzieli mi, że jestem w drużynie!
Dialogue.English: They told me I'm on the team!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_33_0
Dialogue.English: My school is huge.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_33_1
Dialogue.Text: Piłka to dla mnie dużo zabawy.
Dialogue.English: Football is a lot of fun for me.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_34_0
Dialogue.Text: Przejść na drugą stronę? Uważaj na samochody!
Dialogue.English: Cross to the other side? Watch out for cars!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_35_0
Dialogue.Text: Mam dziś trening, a jutro test z angielskiego.
Dialogue.English: I've got training today and an English test tomorrow.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_35_1
Dialogue.English: I didn't understand anything in the lesson.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_36_0
Dialogue.Text: Chłopaka z drużyny nie ma. Jest chory.
Dialogue.English: One of the lads from the team isn't here. He's ill.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_37_0
Dialogue.English: Score a goal? I'll try!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_37_1
Dialogue.English: I'll become a footballer.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_37_2
Dialogue.English: Will you be my fan?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_38_0
Dialogue.English: Congratulations to the team!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_38_1
Dialogue.English: The coach thanks all the lads.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_39_0
Dialogue.English: What's your name?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_39_1
Dialogue.English: Can you play football?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_39_2
Dialogue.English: Are you scared of dogs?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_40_0
Dialogue.English: We can do it!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_40_1
Dialogue.English: We've got a good chance!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_41_0
Dialogue.English: I want to do something big.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_41_1
Dialogue.English: I want to play in a big stadium.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_42_0
Dialogue.Text: Obaj z bratem gramy w piłkę.
Dialogue.English: My brother and I both play football.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_42_1
Dialogue.English: Enough talk, let's play!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_43_0
Dialogue.English: In winter we train indoors.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_43_1
Dialogue.English: I finished school at two.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_44_0
Dialogue.English: We're looking for a new goalkeeper.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_44_1
Dialogue.English: My brother scored the second goal.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_45_0
Dialogue.English: What have they done?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_45_1
Dialogue.English: We'll be back tomorrow!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_46_0
Dialogue.Text: Trener mówi: najważniejsze jest zachowanie na boisku.
Dialogue.English: The coach says: the most important thing is how you behave on the pitch.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_46_1
Dialogue.English: Beat that team? We can do it!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_47_0
Dialogue.English: The best footballer gets a prize.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_47_1
Dialogue.English: They gave me a medal!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_48_0
Dialogue.English: I hit my leg.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_48_1
Dialogue.English: Do you play football?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_49_0
Dialogue.English: In the game it's the team that counts.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_49_1
Dialogue.English: I'm a lad from the pitch.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_50_0
Dialogue.English: Shoot!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_50_1
Dialogue.English: Are you starting or me?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_51_0
Dialogue.English: I heard the whistle and ran.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_51_1
Dialogue.English: Start with a warm-up!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_52_0
Dialogue.English: Just so you all know, I'm the best!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_52_1
Dialogue.English: You're not wrong!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_53_0
Dialogue.English: Nonsense! We'll win!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_53_1
Dialogue.English: My brothers play too.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_54_0
Dialogue.English: Come to the match on Saturday!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_54_1
Dialogue.English: Will you come?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_54_2
Dialogue.English: Are you keeping your fingers crossed?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_55_0
Dialogue.English: Did you all see my goal?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_55_1
Dialogue.English: I scored in the second half.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_56_0
Dialogue.English: I'm as strong as a lion.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_56_1
Dialogue.English: What are you on about?

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_57_0
Dialogue.English: We've lost the ball!

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_57_1
Dialogue.English: I have to defend the goal.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_58_0
Dialogue.English: I didn't get a chance.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_58_1
Dialogue.English: We'll talk after the match.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_59_0
Dialogue.English: My dreams? To play for the national team.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_59_1
Dialogue.English: They call me the Rocket.

Dialogue.Name: bartek_chat_60_0
Dialogue.English: A bigger pitch? Great!

Dialogue.Name: dorota_intro_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Dzień dobry! Jestem pani Dorota, nauczycielka.
Dialogue.English: Good morning! I'm Mrs Dorota, a teacher.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_intro_0_1
Dialogue.English: I have a problem: I've lost the bell.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_intro_0_2
Dialogue.Text: Bez dzwonka dzieci nie wiedzą, kiedy jest przerwa.
Dialogue.English: Without the bell the children don't know when it's break time.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_intro_0_3
Dialogue.Text: Byłam rano w kawiarni, na tarasie. Może tam?
Dialogue.English: I was at the café this morning, on the terrace. Maybe it's there?

Dialogue.Name: dorota_done_0_0
Dialogue.English: My bell! Thank you!

Dialogue.Name: dorota_done_0_1
Dialogue.English: Children, break time!

Dialogue.Name: dorota_remind_0_0
Dialogue.Text: Mój dzwonek jest chyba na tarasie kawiarni.
Dialogue.English: My bell is probably on the café terrace.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_wrong_0_0
Dialogue.English: No, that's not it.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_0_0
Dialogue.English: Children, look at the board!

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_0_1
Dialogue.English: Look, this is a map of Poland.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_1_0
Dialogue.English: Stop talking!

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_1_1
Dialogue.English: Kacper, put your phone down!

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_2_0
Dialogue.English: Let's start the lesson!

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_2_1
Dialogue.English: Open your notebook and write the date.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_3_0
Dialogue.English: What questions do you have?

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_3_1
Dialogue.English: Who knows the answers?

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_3_2
Dialogue.English: Your attention for a moment, please!

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_4_0
Dialogue.English: What do you think of this book?

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_4_1
Dialogue.Text: Z jakiej książki są te pytania?
Dialogue.English: Which book are these questions from?

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_5_0
Dialogue.English: Go out to the pitch, but slowly!

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_5_1
Dialogue.Text: Ze względu na pogodę gramy dziś w sali.
Dialogue.English: Because of the weather we're playing indoors today.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_6_0
Dialogue.English: There are rules at school.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_6_1
Dialogue.English: The rules are for the children's safety.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_7_0
Dialogue.English: The test results are very good.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_7_1
Dialogue.English: I'm proud of them.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_8_0
Dialogue.Text: Uczę w tej szkole od piętnastu lat.
Dialogue.English: I've taught at this school for fifteen years.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_8_1
Dialogue.Text: Pracowałam z matką w jednej szkole.
Dialogue.English: I worked with my mother at the same school.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_9_0
Dialogue.English: Every pupil is different.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_9_1
Dialogue.Text: Każdej klasie daję te same zadania.
Dialogue.English: I give every class the same exercises.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_9_2
Dialogue.English: Every child has great potential.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_10_0
Dialogue.Text: Dyrektor chce, abym uczyła też historii.
Dialogue.English: The head wants me to teach history too.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_10_1
Dialogue.Text: Dyrektor uważa, że to dobry pomysł.
Dialogue.English: The head thinks it's a good idea.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_10_2
Dialogue.English: The head is a nice man.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_11_0
Dialogue.Text: Kacper ma lepsze oceny niż w zeszłym roku.
Dialogue.English: Kacper has better marks than last year.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_11_1
Dialogue.English: Kacper is staying after school today.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_12_0
Dialogue.Text: Reszta klasy jest już na boisku.
Dialogue.English: The rest of the class is already on the pitch.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_12_1
Dialogue.English: We'll do the rest of the lesson tomorrow.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_13_0
Dialogue.Text: Dzisiaj mówimy o historii polskiego króla.
Dialogue.English: Today we're talking about the story of a Polish king.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_13_1
Dialogue.English: The king lived in a big castle.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_14_0
Dialogue.English: Indeed, it's hard, but possible.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_14_1
Dialogue.English: A teacher needs a lot of strength.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_15_0
Dialogue.Text: Najwyraźniej ktoś znowu zostawił otwarte okno.
Dialogue.English: Apparently someone left the window open again.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_16_0
Dialogue.Text: Zadanie domowe na jutro: strona dwadzieścia.
Dialogue.English: Homework for tomorrow: page twenty.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_16_1
Dialogue.English: Take your book and sit down.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_17_0
Dialogue.English: Kacper, give Hania back her pen!

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_17_1
Dialogue.English: Kacper, step outside for a moment.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_18_0
Dialogue.English: Trust me, it's easy.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_18_1
Dialogue.English: The children have to trust me.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_19_0
Dialogue.English: Did you want to say something, Hania?

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_19_1
Dialogue.English: Hania, could you help me?

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_19_2
Dialogue.Text: Widziałaś to, Haniu? Kacper znowu śpi!
Dialogue.English: Did you see that, Hania? Kacper's asleep again!

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_20_0
Dialogue.English: What was that about, Kacper?

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_20_1
Dialogue.Text: Mówię do Kacpra: chcę, abyś czytał więcej.
Dialogue.English: I tell Kacper: I want you to read more.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_21_0
Dialogue.Text: Rodzice muszą odebrać dzieci o czwartej.
Dialogue.English: Parents have to pick the children up at four.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_21_1
Dialogue.Text: Mam kontakt z rodzicami każdego ucznia.
Dialogue.English: I keep in touch with every pupil's parents.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_22_0
Dialogue.English: I'm fair to all the children.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_22_1
Dialogue.English: I know all the pupils' surnames.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_23_0
Dialogue.Text: W klasie mam dwadzieścia cztery osoby.
Dialogue.English: I have twenty-four people in my class.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_23_1
Dialogue.English: I split the class into two groups.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_24_0
Dialogue.English: My aim is a good school.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_24_1
Dialogue.English: Teaching gives me joy.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_25_0
Dialogue.Text: W pierwszym dniu szkoły dzieci płaczą.
Dialogue.English: On the first day of school the children cry.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_25_1
Dialogue.Text: W ostatnich latach wszystkie dzieci mają telefony.
Dialogue.English: In recent years all the children have had phones.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_26_0
Dialogue.Text: Dyrektor chciałby, byśmy mieli nowe komputery.
Dialogue.English: The head would like us to have new computers.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_26_1
Dialogue.English: The children play with their toys.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_27_0
Dialogue.English: The children helped me find my keys.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_28_0
Dialogue.English: Girls, sit down!

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_28_1
Dialogue.English: Anyone can ask a question.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_29_0
Dialogue.English: Answer the question, Kacper.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_29_1
Dialogue.English: Who wants to answer?

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_30_0
Dialogue.English: I repeat: notebooks on the desks!

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_30_1
Dialogue.English: I have no intention of shouting.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_31_0
Dialogue.Text: Wszyscy mają zadanie, z wyjątkiem Hani.
Dialogue.English: Everyone has homework, except Hania.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_31_1
Dialogue.English: I teach children respect.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_32_0
Dialogue.Text: Każdy ma swoją rolę w klasie.
Dialogue.English: Everyone has their role in the class.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_32_1
Dialogue.English: Tomorrow I'll bring a map of the world.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_33_0
Dialogue.English: It's written on the board.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_33_1
Dialogue.Text: Kto napisał to wypracowanie? Jest świetne!
Dialogue.English: Who wrote this essay? It's great!

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_34_0
Dialogue.English: Hania deserves top marks!

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_34_1
Dialogue.English: Tomorrow we'll carry on.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_35_0
Dialogue.English: I want to introduce a new pupil to you.

Dialogue.Name: dorota_chat_35_1
